outfits.name: Voidjelly
outfits.description: Voidjellies are poisonous and have almost no commercial value. They are, however, a favorite food of certain large Voidfish that are immune to the toxin. A high enough concentration of them within a water droplet is likely to attract a Voidlunker.

outfits.name: Voidlunker
outfits.description: Occasionally, a voidborne fish grows to a particularly large size. These lunkers are highly prized among a small community of fishing enthusiasts. Such specimens are preserved through a process, similar to taxidermy, for display in private collections. 	This is a rare catch. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Murkfish
outfits.description: Most of the voidborne fish found in the dark waters of Murk appear even more alien than those caught in Gossamer. This exotic appearance is enhanced by a larger representation of species exhibiting some form of bioluminescence.

outfits.name: Rotting Murk Flesh
outfits.description: A chunk of rotting flesh found scattered through out the waters of Murk. The size and shape suggest these came from something larger than a capital ship... 	The flesh itself is too far gone to have any market value, but it is teeming with crustaceans, mollusks, and other small invertebrates feeding upon it. These scavengers seem like they might be edible if cooked properly.

outfits.name: Wither Wood
outfits.description: Underneath the tree's rotting exterior, Wither Wood shines with an unearthly glow. The bio-matter has been imbued with high levels of radioactive uranium. Whether natural evolution or artificial bio-engineering caused this is a mystery. Some may find this substance useful as an alternative energy source or weapons development material. But it probably wouldn't be a good idea to sell these at a concerts as glow sticks.

outfits.name: Orange Optical Laser
outfits.description: The three lasers mounted on this heavy turret are effective at smelting asteroids and harvesting other interstellar resources. They also generate more heat than most other Avgi lasers, both on the ship they are installed on as well as any ship they strike. An optical lasing generator is integrated into the weapon, contributing to its considerable size and weight.

outfits.name: Prismatic Optical Laser
outfits.description: This heavy turret was designed during a time when the Avgi were still uncertain which wavelengths are ideal for defending against missiles. An integrated optical lasing generator cycles through the spectrum, creating a dazzling effect that greatly disrupts optical tracking systems.

outfits.name: Red Optical Laser
outfits.description: This specialized gun was designed for smelting asteroids and harvesting other interstellar resources. An optical lasing generator is integrated into the weapon, making it simpler to install but less compatible with modern Avgi laser weapons.

outfits.name: Speck Magazine Depot
outfits.description: The Speck Magazine Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Speck Rounds. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Deflector Lamina
outfits.description: These shield emitters can be mounted conformally to a ship's hull, adding to the shield coverage of the hull surface by half. This causes the shield generators to work harder than they normally would, doubling all resource requirements to restore lost shields. 	Deflector Laminae take advantage of special external hardpoints built into most Avgi ships, allowing them to be mounted without taking up any outfit space. However, they also tend to increase the amount of heat absorbed from the local star.

outfits.name: Harvester Scanner
outfits.description: This compact scanner is configured to assist short range data collection for Void Harvesters instead of providing long range tactical data.

outfits.name: Harvester Spectrometer
outfits.description: This compact set of spectrometers is specialized for analyzing the spectral signatures of natural raw materials in order to determine their composition. It lacks the functionality to identify manufactured goods and equipment.

outfits.name: Avgi Harvester License
outfits.description: While wearing this pendant, the Avgi will recognize you as a competent Void Harvester and offer you access to their more specialized harvesting tools and ships. 	The tiny Voidfish dangling from the chain looks remarkably life-like. Shaking it back and forth makes it appear as if it's trying to slip off a fishing hook.

outfits.name: Bunrodean Artifact License
outfits.description: The outfitter occasionally shows off rare artifacts that aren't actually for sale.

outfits.name: Swarm Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Swarm Missiles. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Swarm Missiles even if it is normally not stocked there. 	Amazingly, this is written in your language! The outfitter is presenting it as a curiosity left behind by a previous human visitor to their space. Unfortunately, it is not for sale. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Swarm Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Swarm Missiles. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Swarm Missiles even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: Swarm Access Temporary License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Swarm Missiles. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Swarm Missiles even if it is normally not stocked there. 	Amazingly, this is written in your language! The outfitter is presenting it as a curiosity left behind by a previous human visitor to their space. Unfortunately, it is not for sale. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Swarm Clip Depot
outfits.description: The Swarm Clip Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Swarm Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Thermal Insulator
outfits.description: The Bunrodea learned that Korath ships are susceptible to overheating and developed this device to exacerbate that weakness on ships that tried to board them. Thermal Insulators reduce the cooling efficiency of any ship they are installed on. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Lasher Rifle
outfits.description: Unlike modern Lasher Pistols, this weapon utilizes brutally savage design principles more suitable for attack than defense. It is a testament to a less civilized era in Bunrodean antiquity.

outfits.name: Heliarch Corruption
outfits.description: Evidence of corrupt activities involving a Heliarch official.

outfits.name: Camouflaged Blaster
outfits.description: Someone redesigned an old Energy Cannon to resemble a Coalition Model Cannon. The outer casing incorporates scanning interference material to help conceal its internal circuitry. These weapons are popular with both criminals and dissidents within the Coalition, allowing them to covertly arm their ships without drawing attention from the Heliarchs.

outfits.name: Camouflaged Blaster Turret
outfits.description: Three Energy Cannons disguised to resemble Coalition Model Cannons are mounted on this turret. The outer casing incorporates scanning interference material to help conceal its internal circuitry.

outfits.name: Coalition Attractor
outfits.description: Coalition Attractors played a pivotal role in the Saryd's ability to control early battles against the Quarg. Heliarch technicians would later refine this technology into a more powerful weapon.

outfits.name: Coalition Repulsor
outfits.description: Coalition Repulsors allowed Saryd escorts to keep enemy ships away from vulnerable targets. However, they lack some of the features that the Heliarch would later develop when enhancing this technology.

outfits.name: Deflector Emitter
outfits.description: The Deflector Emitter was an accidental invention that came about during the development of the Heliarch Repulsor. It supplements shield coverage over the ship, helping to protect it from asteroids or other debris. 	In addition to occupying a turret mount, each emitter installed will increase stress on the shield generators, raising consumption of resources used to replenish your shields.

outfits.name: Model Cannon
outfits.description: This Model Cannon is a non-functional representation of an actual Bombardment Cannon. Civilian ship collectors in the Coalition use these to decorate their ships for added aesthetic authenticity.

outfits.name: Model Turret
outfits.description: This Model Turret is a non-functional representation of an actual Bombardment Turret. Civilian ship collectors in the Coalition use these to decorate their ships for added aesthetic authenticity.

outfits.name: Culminator Pod
outfits.description: Culminator Torpedoes are an antique design that eventually lead to development of the modern Finishers in use by the Heliarch. Old forgotten weapons caches of these are sometimes found hidden throughout Coalition space. 	Unlike Finishers, Culminators launch hot. This shortens their range since they burn out more quickly.

outfits.name: Culminator Storage Tube
outfits.description: Culminator Storage Tubes are more compact than Finisher Storage Tubes, but lack the additional energy storage capacity of its modern counterpart.

outfits.name: Culminator Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Culminator Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Culminator Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Culminator Torpedo
outfits.description: This extremely powerful missile is ammunition for the Coalition Culminator Pod. Not as maneuverable as a Finisher Torpedo and equipped with simpler tracking technology, a Culminator strike is still as destructive as that of their modern equivalents.

outfits.name: Finisher Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Finisher Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Finisher Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Coalition Scanner
outfits.description: This antique scanner is far less powerful than the Scanning Modules used by the Heliarchs, but it has additional features more suitable for exploration and research.

outfits.name: Fuel Dissipator
outfits.description: The Heliarch developed this device for their boarding crews to prevent dissidents from escaping after a boarding skirmish. The Fuel Dissipator works by tapping into the fuel system of the ship it is installed on and inducing a leak. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Coalition Reactor Cluster
outfits.description: Coalition Reactor Clusters are less modular than their modern Heliarch equivalents.

outfits.name: Riot Containment Barrier
outfits.description: A simple crowd control barrier made from the same durable alloys found in spaceship hulls. Easy to set up and difficult to break through, they can be surprisingly effective at blocking passage through the corridors of a ship. 	While Riot Containment Barriers are typically deployed by the Heliarchs to keep civil unrest under control, these are technically not weapons. A growing market of citizens concerned about dissidents is starting to have these installed on their ships.

outfits.name: Saryd Light Lance
outfits.description: This lance is a traditional Saryd hunting weapon that is rarely seen outside of the Coalition Games during the modern era. Private ownership of these weapons are strictly regulated and monitored by the Heliarchs. 	The tip of this spear charges and holds an energy bolt that can be used to enhance the wielder's strikes in melee or be flung at an enemy from a distance.

outfits.name: Finisher Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Finisher Torpedos. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Finisher Torpedos even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The knowledge for recreating Heliarch technology is not available to the general public. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Ignus-Lance
outfits.description: The Ignus-Lance is a short-range beam weapon that inflicts intense heat damage to anything it strikes.

outfits.name: Combustion Torpedo
outfits.description: Combustion Torpedoes are ammunition for the Combustion Launcher. Each Combustion Launcher can hold 27 of them. You cannot install torpedoes unless you have also installed a launcher to fire them from.

outfits.name: Combustion Storage Rack
outfits.description: The Combustion Storage Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Combustion Launchers.

outfits.name: Combustion Depot
outfits.description: The Combustion Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Combustion Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Combustion Launcher
outfits.description: Combustion Torpedoes create a small nuclear reaction that irradiates the target with residual heat after the initial impact. The infrared tracking makes it easier for subsequent torpedoes to find their target.

outfits.name: Solar Scoop
outfits.description: These simple ramscoops provide fuel for several Ignitian outfits.

outfits.name: Blood Drive
outfits.description: Somehow, the technological development of the Ignitia skipped the Hyperdrive and leaped directly to a rudimentary Jump Drive. While this device is limited to travel along hyperspace lanes, it is clear that their researchers are on course to figuring out how to make true Jump Drives.

outfits.name: Bloodstone Drive
outfits.description: The workings of the jump drive are a total mystery. The best that human scientists have been able to find out is that this device is a containment field for matter in a state that cannot normally exist in this universe; if the drive is opened up, the field collapses and its contents disappear. Therefore, even though a few jump drives have been captured over the years, it has so far proved impossible to reverse engineer them. 	This Jump Drive is manufactured with special materials that give it a quality which regular Jump Drives lack.

outfits.name: Cauldron Core
outfits.description: The Ignitia seem to regard the Cauldron Core with a sense of mysticism. Maintaining it involves the performance of rituals which do not appear to have any relation to its generated output.

outfits.name: Crucible Core
outfits.description: The Ignitia seem to regard the Crucible Core with a sense of mysticism. Maintaining it involves the performance of rituals which do not appear to have any relation to its generated output.

outfits.name: Rubicon Capacitor
outfits.description: These crystals can store a surprising amount of power in a compact form. They are easily found on Ignus, the Ignitia homeworld. 	The capacitors tend to leak small amounts of energy but are well suited to absorbing heat.

outfits.name: Ignitian Engines
outfits.description: The Ignitia incorporate afterburners into every engine design. Separating them is an alien concept that they find incomprehensible.

outfits.name: Combustion Torpedo Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Combustion Torpedos. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Combustion Torpedos even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The version available for purchase is written in an alien language you don't understand... 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Combustion Torpedo Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Combustion Torpedos. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Combustion Torpedos even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: Justicar Executar License
outfits.description: Justicar Code of Conduct Statute 0066 Subsection 6 paragraph 6: 	Only Executars appointed by the Justicar Court may purchase equipment sold at Justicar outfitters.

outfits.name: Injunction Gun
outfits.description: Injunction Guns are the simplest weapons wielded by the Justicars.

outfits.name: Injunction Cannon
outfits.description: Injunction Cannons generate concussive blasts that knock perpetrators away from your ship.

outfits.name: Injunction Turret
outfits.description: Injunction Cannons generate concussive blasts that knock perpetrators away from your ship. This weapon features a single Injunction Cannon mounted on a rotating turret mount.

outfits.name: Deliberation Shielding
outfits.description: This shield generator requires some time to activate before recharging the shields. Altering this device for continuous operation was forbidden under Justicar laws against wasteful energy use and heat pollution.

outfits.name: Reparation System
outfits.description: This hull repair system requires some time to activate before repairing the hull. Altering this device for continuous operation was forbidden under Justicar laws against wasteful energy use and heat pollution.

outfits.name: Interrogation Scanner
outfits.description: This Justicar device is one tool used to ensure that the Justicar Code of Conduct is adhered to within their territory.

outfits.name: Incarceration Cell
outfits.description: The harshest punishment in Justicar society is lifetime imprisonment in an Incarceration Cell. The convicts are kept in cryo stasis, unconscious to the world around them. An emergency cooling system powered by the occupant's own life force activates if the cell is exposed to high temperatures. 	Most civilized species view this type of punishment as a form of cruel slavery.

outfits.name: Large Incarceration Cell
outfits.description: This newer model Incarceration Cell was made possible by a alternative source of convicts. Unfortunately, supplies are low. The Executars are investigating these suspects to help improve the rate of prosecutions. 	Most civilized species view this type of punishment as a form of cruel slavery.

outfits.name: Jurisdiction Core
outfits.description: Authority is meaningless without the power to enforce it. This fission reactor provides the Justicar with the power to wield their tools of lawfare.

outfits.name: Continuance Engine
outfits.description: Justicar engines are a hybrid of ion and plasma technology. While maneuverable, their maximum potential speed is slow.

outfits.name: Movant Engine
outfits.description: Justicar engines are a hybrid of ion and plasma technology. While maneuverable, their maximum potential speed is slow.

outfits.name: Graviton Channeler
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Quantum Paradox Diffusion
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Quantum Paradox Inversion
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Quantum Paradox Propulsion
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Imaginary Number Fusion Matrix
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Omni-Directional Photonic Emitter
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Space Differential Stabilizer
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Zero Division Core
outfits.description: You have no idea how this works.

outfits.name: Murkspores
outfits.description: If these spores are left on your ship, Murkmold may eventually start growing there.

outfits.name: Murkmold Bay
outfits.description: This portion of your cargo bay is infested with Murkmold. Most sentient species quickly ban it once they discover its dangerous hallucinogenic effects...

outfits.name: Murkmold Bunks
outfits.description: This bunk room is infested with Murkmold, a protein rich primordial ooze that forms on Murkmold patches. While in this state, it is uninhabitable for your crew.

outfits.name: Murkmold
outfits.description: You hear a whispering voice: 	"Grow the mold..." 	"Protect the mold..." 	"Spread the mold..."

outfits.name: Rock Scavenger Meat
outfits.description: Although it looks disgusting, rock scavenger meat is considered a delicacy in the Paradise Planets. Restaurants will pay large sums of money for it.

outfits.name: Pollen?
outfits.description: This granule of exotic pollen is not only replete with nutritious proteins, but also appears to contain valuable platinum group elements bound in organic molecules. This includes a collection of complex enzymes, which appear to be capable of catalyzing many difficult reactions with ease. 	Achoo!

outfits.name: Murkspores?
outfits.description: If these spores are aboard your ship, some sort of fungus may eventually start growing there.

outfits.name: Bioroid (Crushed)
outfits.description: The bioroid's delicate casing was crushed. The scrambled biomatter leaking out leaves a goopy mess on the floor.

outfits.name: Liquid Metal Specimen
outfits.description: Specimen ID Number: HG-80 Source: Moktar Notes: Multimorphic Nanomachines. Can mimic shape, not color. Property of The Syndicate. Biohazard. Do not open. If found, return to the Syndicate offices at the Foundry spaceport in the Achernar system.

outfits.name: Gray Eye Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of a Gray Eye. This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Luminazoa Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of a Luminazoa. It glows in the dark. This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Leech Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of an Ionic Leech. You feel static electricity clinging to the surface of the container. This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Nautilus Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of an Astero Nautilus. You're almost certain that one of the tentacles just twitched... This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Plasma Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of a Plasma Parasite. Handle with care. This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Firefly Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of a Nova Firefly. The surface of the container feels warm. This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Gazer Specimen
outfits.description: The slimy goopy remains of a Star Gazer. The eye seems to be staring at you... This is a rare specimen. You can install it on your ship to keep it from getting mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Nightmare Fuel License
outfits.description: You have witnessed things rational minds were not meant to see. Now, strange phantoms hover just beyond your field of vision and you hear faint echoes breaking moments of silence. It is as if the thin veneer of sanity has been torn ever so slightly, granting you awareness of another reality interposed with our own...

outfits.name: Haunted Accommodations
outfits.description: Passengers claim this room is haunted. Those assigned to it report seeing strange visions or hearing weird sounds during their voyage. Although this is supposed to be Luxury Accommodations, it no longer attracts high quality customers. Instead, this is attracting clients of a different sort... 	Ever since you had your own strange experience here you haven't set foot in it again. The Haunted Accomodations appears normal, but ship status reports indicate that it no longer occupies as much space as it used to.

outfits.name: Unknown Element
outfits.description: This doesn't match anything in your ship's database. It could be very valuable to the right person.

outfits.name: Light Scrap Plating
outfits.description: Durable hull scraps can sometimes be salvaged from the wreckage littering Gegno battlefields. These hardened remains are representative of a particularly well constructed Gegno ship. 	This must go through a smelting process with certain materials to weld it to your hull. 	Welding this onto your hull will slow your ship down considerably. While it can be layered for more protection, the added weight is also cumulative.

outfits.name: Heavy Scrap Plating
outfits.description: Durable hull scraps can sometimes be salvaged from the wreckage littering Gegno battlefields. These battle hardened remains probably came from an especially durable Vi war ship. 	This must go through a smelting process with certain materials to weld it to your hull. 	Welding this onto your hull will slow your ship down considerably. While it can be layered for more protection, the added weight is also cumulative.

outfits.name: Thermal Scrap Plating
outfits.description: Durable hull scraps can sometimes be salvaged from the wreckage littering Gegno battlefields. The remains of certain Scin ships are somewhat resistant to heat. Perhaps this is the result of experimental hull manufacturing techniques. 	This must go through a smelting process with certain materials to weld it to your hull. Welding this onto your hull will slow your ship down considerably. While it can be layered for more protection, the added weight is also cumulative.

outfits.name: Slag
outfits.description: Slag leftover from obliterated hull plating. Weapons fire from dozens of battles have rendered its base metals unrecognizable and unsalvageable.

outfits.name: Aluminum Ingot
outfits.description: Aluminum that has been processed for industrial use. Each one should be stamped with a manufacturer's seal certifying the purity of its content. If the stamp is missing or damaged, the ingot's value plummets to it's spot price.

outfits.name: Genesis Mining Laser
outfits.description: This is bulky laser isn't very effective against shields. The inhabitants of Genesis have put it to use as a mining tool, allowing their ships to save ammunition for threats more dangerous than asteroids.

outfits.name: Genesis Anti-Missile
outfits.description: Genesis Anti-Missile turrets require a crew member to operate and have some other minor differences from the similarly sized Anti-Missile Turrets used by humans.

outfits.name: Genesis Repair Bot
outfits.description: This large robot is able to patch holes in the hull of a ship that is still in flight. When not in use, it occupies a turret mount to recharge.

outfits.name: Genesis Flak Shell
outfits.description: Genesis Flak Shells are ammunition for the Genesis Flak Turret. Each turret holds up to 40 shells. 	Genesis ammunition, professionally manufactured by their industrial mass production factories, is a critical element to many of their weapons. Quality control measures at these facilities make them less likely to jam.

outfits.name: Genesis Flak Shell Crate
outfits.description: The Genesis Flak Shell Crate is used to store extra ammunition for Genesis Flak Turrets.

outfits.name: Genesis Flak Shell Depot
outfits.description: The Genesis Flak Shell Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Genesis Flak Shells. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Genesis Flak Turret
outfits.description: This is a turret mounted anti-spacecraft weapon that fires Genesis Flak Shells. The blast caused from their impact can affect friend and foe alike. 	Genesis mechanical weapons technology is far ahead of their energy weapons development. The loading systems on them are less likely to jam compared to species that put more resources on developing their energy weapons.

outfits.name: Frozen Shard Turret
outfits.description: This turret uses cryogenic technology to launch shards of frozen deuterium at its target. While they lack the durability and explosive quality of Genesis Flak Shells, it is easier to locate deuterium on a deep space excursion than it is to replenish conventional forms of ammunition. 	Genesis mechanical weapons technology is far ahead of their energy weapons development. The loading systems on them are less likely to jam compared to species that put more resources on developing their energy weapons.

outfits.name: High Calibur Ammo
outfits.description: In simple terms, "caliber" refers to the diameter of a gun's barrel. Guns are meant to be loaded with bullets that match their caliber. This ammunition is appropriately sized to be used with the High Caliber Gun. Attempting to load it with lower caliber ammunition can result in jamming or other firing mishaps. 	Genesis ammunition, professionally manufactured by their industrial mass production factories, is a critical element to many of their weapons. Quality control measures at these facilities make them less likely to jam.

outfits.name: High Calibur Boxes
outfits.description: High Caliber Ammo Boxes are used to store extra ammunition for High Caliber Guns.

outfits.name: High Calibur Depot
outfits.description: The High Caliber stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use High Caliber Ammo. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: High Calibur Gun
outfits.description: The bullets used to load this weapon are of a higher caliber than the ones used in pirate Gatling Guns. The High Caliber Gun does greater damage while having a higher accuracy and consistency with every shot. Its rate of fire is also more steady. 	Genesis mechanical weapons technology is far ahead of their energy weapons development. The loading systems on them are less likely to jam compared to species that put more resources on developing their energy weapons.

outfits.name: Hydrogen Missile
outfits.description: While not quite as powerful as the Nuclear Missiles you are familiar with, the inhabitants of Genesis don't appear to have any aversion to sharing this technology with you. 	Genesis ammunition, professionally manufactured by their industrial mass production factories, is a critical element to many of their weapons. Quality control measures at these facilities make them less likely to jam. 	[Hydrogen Missiles are a one-shot weapon: each missile occupies a gun slot, and after it is fired, the slot it was in is left empty.]

outfits.name: Icicle Gun
outfits.description: This weapon utilizes cryogenic technology to convert hyperspace fuel into frozen deuterium bullets. While capable of a high fire rate, the time it takes to freeze more bullets can take twice as long as it does to expend them. At most, it can only sustain a maximum of three seconds of continuous fire. 	Genesis mechanical weapons technology is far ahead of their energy weapons development. The loading systems on them are less likely to jam compared to species that put more resources on developing their energy weapons.

outfits.name: Cryogenic Cooler
outfits.description: A Cryogenic Cooler applies cryogenic technology to efficiently maintain the internal temperature of your ship.

outfits.name: Cryogenic Hub
outfits.description: By itself, a Cryogenic Hub merely adds some cooling to your ship. Its actual purpose is to allow Cryogenic Coolers or other cryogenic technologies to be attached into its slots.

outfits.name: Cryostasis Pod
outfits.description: Most travelers will balk at the notion of riding in one of these. But there may be opportunities to transport dangerous prisoners or sensitive cargo that would otherwise be unavailable without one. 	A Cryostasis Pod continuously draws on a modest amount of power to maintain a temperature controlled environment within. If the external temperature becomes excessive, it will pull on additional power to compensate.

outfits.name: Genesis Narrowband Scanner
outfits.description: Genesis Narrowband Scanners are incredibly efficient once locked onto a target, but have a very short range.

outfits.name: Hydrogen Collector
outfits.description: This ramscoop is a necessary component in keeping fuel hungry ships from Genesis operational.

outfits.name: Genesis Battery
outfits.description: Genesis Batteries feature a high capacity for their size but they are more vulnerable to energy draining attacks than batteries of other species.

outfits.name: Genesis Fission
outfits.description: Fission Reactors used by the inhabitants of Genesis are very efficient at generating energy, but the methods used to make this possible leave them vulnerable against ionization.

outfits.name: Genesis Radiothermal
outfits.description: Radiothermal generators used by the inhabitants of Genesis are very efficient at generating energy, but the methods used to make this possible leave them vulnerable against ionization.

outfits.name: Genesis Photovoltaic Array
outfits.description: This solar collection array is more weight efficient than the ones commonly found in human space, but is also less sophisticated.

outfits.name: Genesis Photovoltaic Panel
outfits.description: The inhabitants of Genesis have solar collection technology that is less developed than other space faring species.

outfits.name: Genesis Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This fuel cells used by the inhabitants of Genesis are very efficient at generating energy, but the methods used to make this possible leave them vulnerable against ionization.

outfits.name: Genesis Afterburner
outfits.description: Genesis Afterburners use a small amount of fuel combined with a burst of energy from your ship's batteries to produce a large amount of thrust.

outfits.name: Genesis Engines
outfits.description: Genesis Engines burn a small amount of hyperspace fuel to provide turning and thrusting to their ships.

outfits.name: Anti-Missile
outfits.description: This is similar to the Anti-Missile Turret you're familiar with. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Laser
outfits.description: This is similar to the Beam Laser you're familiar with. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Gat
outfits.description: This is similar to the Gatling Gun you're familiar with. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Tiny Battery
outfits.description: This is a tiny battery. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Small Battery
outfits.description: This is a small battery. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Medium Battery
outfits.description: This is a medium battery. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Engines
outfits.description: This is a compact steering and thrusting engine. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Battery
outfits.description: This is a battery. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Fusion
outfits.description: This is a fusion reactor. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Radiothermal
outfits.description: Radiothermal generators harvest heat from radioactive isotopes and convert it into electricity. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Scanner
outfits.description: This scanner allows you to determine what outfits are installed in the ship you are currently targeting, as well as scan the cargo holds. Installing more than one increases the scan range and speed. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Small Photovoltaic
outfits.description: This generates power when near a star. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Thermionic
outfits.description: Thermionic radioisotopic generators are a cooler-running alternative to other generators. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Tiny Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This tiny fuel cell generates power when installed on a ship. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Genesis Thermionic
outfits.description: Thermionic radioisotopic generators used by the inhabitants of Genesis are very efficient at generating energy, but the methods used to make this possible leave them vulnerable against ionization. 	This deprecated outfit may be removed from the plugin in a future update.

outfits.name: Heavy Pulse Cannon
outfits.description: An antique rarely seen on modern Hai ships, many consider Heavy Pulse Cannons obsolete. However this weapon would be a valid alternative as a substitute for an Ion Cannon. It lacks the ability to disrupt an enemy ship's energy systems, but the power of its shots should not be underestimated.

outfits.name: Hoarder Beam
outfits.description: Hai tractor technology has greater range than human Tractor Beams. It was more common in the ancient Hai empire. Among modern Hai, only the Unfettered still utilize it.

outfits.name: Ion Pulse Cannon
outfits.description: Deployed at the start of the Unfettered invasion of Wanderer space, Ion Pulse Cannons disrupt the electrical systems on any ship they hit. Individually, they aren't as effective as Ion Cannons, but these weapons are meant to be used in multiples. As a group they synchronize their rate of fire, creating waves of ionizing projectiles.

outfits.name: Ion Pulse Turret
outfits.description: Featuring a single Ion Pulse Cannon mounted onto a rotating turret base, this weapon does less damage than the similarly sized Pulse Turret. Despite this, some Unfettered captains consider the option to deliver additional ion damage from a turret mount well worth the trade-off. 	These turrets are designed to synchronize their rate of fire with each other as well as non-turreted Ion Pulse Cannons.

outfits.name: Komodo Anti-Missile
outfits.description: Komodo Anti-Missiles are more powerful than other Hai anti-missile systems, but their large space requirements compromises the offensive capabilities of the Unfettered ships they are installed on. 	Long dormant projects to produce and distribute stronger anti-missile systems were reactivated after the Unfettered encountered Wanderer Thunderheads.

outfits.name: Pulse Repeater
outfits.description: Favored by Unfettered captains who want to maximize damage from hit and run strikes, Pulse Repeaters can unleash a rapid burst of projectiles followed by a lengthy cool down period. This gives the pilot time to reposition before firing the next volley. 	Inspired by alien weapons installed on the ships of a hostile species the Hai fought long ago, Pulse Repeaters aren't for sale at Unfettered outfitters. However, any Unfettered engineer worth their acorns should be able to convert a regular Pulse Cannon into one. Whether or not they would be willing to do so is a separate issue.

outfits.name: Pulse Repeater Turret
outfits.description: A pair of Pulse Repeaters mounted onto a turret allow for powerful hit and run attacks with a rapid burst of projectiles followed by a lengthy cool down period. Focusing fire with all of your turrets is essential to taking full advantage of this feature. 	Unfettered outfitters are unwilling to stock this weapon due to the potential of an alien inspired modification being perceived as superior to the original Hai version. Despite this, more than a few Unfettered starship captains have commissioned these conversions to gain an edge on the battlefield.

outfits.name: Hai Displacer
outfits.description: This is ammunition for a Displacer Pod. 	The Displacer only generates holographic decoys after it launches. Managing ammunition inventory would be unnecessarily difficult otherwise.

outfits.name: Displacer Storage Pod
outfits.description: The Displacer Storage Pod is used to store extra ammunition for Displacer Pods. 	The Unfettered now have a new hazing ritual to torture fresh recruits: They are instructed to double check the inventory and confirm that none of the stored Displacers are holographic.

outfits.name: Displacer Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Displacer Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Hai Displacers. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Hai Displacer Pod
outfits.description: Displacers are Trackers that have had their optical tracking hardware replaced with holographic projectors. These create phantom missiles that escort the Displacer towards its target, helping it to slip through the enemy's anti-missile defenses. 	Unfettered engineers attempted to mitigate the loss of optical tracking by improving accuracy during launch and installing additional infrared sensors.

outfits.name: Hai Nutcracker
outfits.description: The Hai once deployed Nutcracker missiles long ago against an enemy occupying a galactic region far from their space. The campaign didn't end well. After it was over, this weapon was abandoned over concerns about its collateral damage and potential lingering effects resulting from prolonged use. 	This weapon is no longer in production. It is a relic from an age of Hai domination and galactic conquest. 	[Nutcracker missiles are a one-shot weapon: each missile occupies a gun slot, and after it is fired, the slot it was in is left empty.]

outfits.name: Phantom Tracker (Gun)
outfits.description: The Phantom Tracker generates a realistic hologram of a Hai Tracker missile. At minimum, the enemy anti-missile defense wastes resources firing at it. But this can also serve as a decoy to allow other, real, missiles through to hit their target. 	Because the missile isn't real, guidance is accomplished entirely through visual positioning data fed into the Phantom Tracker.

outfits.name: Phantom Tracker (Turret)
outfits.description: Hai tacticians were taught to look for the tell-tale signs of Phantom Trackers. They have a shorter range than real Trackers due to limitations of the holographic technology. They move slightly faster. And undisciplined gunners will fire them more often than real tracker pods can. 	Fortunately, most Hai tacticians are either retired or among the Unfettered.

outfits.name: Tracker Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Tracker Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Hai Trackers. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to oversee maintenance of the ammunition.

outfits.name: Railgun Slug Depot
outfits.description: The Railgun Slug Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Railgun Slugs. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Hai Heliotrope Regenerator
outfits.description: Heliotrope Regenerators have carried legendary warriors though the bloodiest of conflicts. However, the extreme heat it generates proved disastrous when the Hai faced an enemy prepared to abuse that weakness. Now, only the most courageous of the True Hai dare to install this on their ships.

outfits.name: Hai Mistral Cooling
outfits.description: The Unfettered once fought enemies whose weapons pushed their ships well past safe heat levels. Mistral Cooling systems were developed to defend against such attacks.

outfits.name: Ionic Snare
outfits.description: Any ship an Ionic Snare is installed on will have its power systems disrupted. The Hai developed this device during the Korath invasion to give their crews a way to sabotage enemy ships that got close enough to board. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Modified Hyperdrive (Hai)
outfits.description: At its height, the Hai empire stretched across an expanse almost double the size of human space. Fluctuator Drives are a relic of this bygone age. They are the result of research into making a fuel efficient Hyperdrive for facilitating travel from one end of the empire to the other.

outfits.name: Modified Nugget Finder
outfits.description: As its name suggests, the Nugget Finder was originally used by the ancient Hai to mine asteroids and harvest gas giants. However, the Unfettered discovered that a few subtle adjustments allow it to target a ship and identify the outfits it has installed.

outfits.name: Quantum Bloodstone
outfits.description: A rare variant of the Quantum Keystone. Hai who prefer these treat them with an awe and reverence that almost seems fanatical. 	Quantum Bloodstones aren't for sale at regular outfitters. The few Hai who have them keep their source a closely guarded secret.

outfits.name: Dual Pulse Pistols
outfits.description: A pair of modified heavy pulse pistols favored by some Unfettered and the occasional pirate captain. Dual wielding them adds another gun during short raids against a ship's defenders. Individually, they lose their energy charge more quickly than a pulse rifle, making them a poor choice for holding a defensive position during a long siege.

outfits.name: Ion Flash Bang
outfits.description: Ion Flash Bangs are defensive weapons used by the Hai to create a disruptive ion burst that drains energy weapons of their charge while causing mechanical weapons to jam.

outfits.name: Ion Pulse Shotgun
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this appears to be a heavily modified Hai Pulse Rifle. Twin barrels fire a pair of ion pulse blasts that collide as they rush towards the target, bursting into a spread that affects a wide area. Mechanical weapons caught in the blast temporarily become inoperable. Ironically, due to the intensity of the recoil, smaller species such as the Hai may find this weapon difficult to wield.

outfits.name: Quantum Dragon Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. The blade is forged from a single Quantum Key Stone of the highest quality. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip, the technological secrets of which have been lost to antiquity, sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard has an intricate carving of a dragon on it. Holding it fills you with a sense of determination.

outfits.name: Quantum Key Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. The blade is forged from a single Quantum Key Stone of the highest quality. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip, the technological secrets of which have been lost to antiquity, sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter.

outfits.name: Quantum Phoenix Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard of this Quantum Key Blade has an intricate carving of a phoenix on it. You feel warm and refreshed while holding it.

outfits.name: Quantum Snake Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard of this Quantum Key Blade has an intricate carving of a snake on it. Holding it fills you with a sense of mischief.

outfits.name: Quantum Tiger Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard of this Quantum Key Blade has an intricate carving of a tiger on it. It consumes a fair bit of energy while charging. You feel invigorated just from holding it in your hands.

outfits.name: Quantum Turtle Blade
outfits.description: This Quantum Key Blade is an ancient Hai artifact from the era when their people still waged war on other alien races across the galaxy. A design of the micro circuitry in the hand grip sends a charge through the blade that alters the wielder's quantum alignment, granting the ability to walk through walls or other solid matter. The hand guard of this Quantum Key Blade has an intricate carving of a turtle on it. You feel contemplative and aloof while in possession of it.

outfits.name: Unfettered Militia License
outfits.description: The Unfettered Militia license exists in both verbal and physical form: Simply claim that you have one. If anyone objects, physically convince them of their error in judgement. It's the Unfettered way.

outfits.name: Tracker Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Trackers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Trackers even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Tracker Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Trackers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Trackers even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: Railgun Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Railgun Slugs. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Railgun Slugs even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Railgun Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Railgun Slugs. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Railgun Slugs even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: Displacer Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Displacers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Displacers even if it is normally not stocked there. 	Only the True Hai may access the secret technology for making Unfettered weapons. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Displacer Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Displacers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Displacers even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Trackers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Trackers even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Railgun Slugs. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Railgun Slugs even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.
