outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Hai Displacers. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Hai Displacers even if it is normally not stocked there. 	Only the True Hai may access the secret technology for making Unfettered weapons. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Prototype Ramscoop FCX
outfits.description: This prototype isn't working as intended...

outfits.name: Prototype Lodestone Engine MDX
outfits.description: This prototype isn't working as intended...

outfits.name: Prototype Shield Modulator SD-DSD
outfits.description: This prototype isn't working as intended...

outfits.name: Prototype Cooling HGX
outfits.description: This prototype isn't working as intended...

outfits.name: Prototype Power Converter ECX
outfits.description: This prototype isn't working as intended...

outfits.name: Secret Prototype
outfits.description: A secret prototype stolen from a merchant vessel. You have no idea how it works.

outfits.name: Smuggled Cargo
outfits.description: Cargo stolen from a smuggler which has caught the interest of a pirate warlord.

outfits.name: Secret Data
outfits.description: Secret data on an encrypted chip. You have no clue what the contents are.

outfits.name: Barracks
outfits.description: This converts part of your cargo bay into barracks for use by combat grunts. Typically, the living conditions in these cramped quarters are unsuitable for paying passengers.

outfits.name: Barracks (Burned)
outfits.description: This barracks was looted and burned during a previous boarding battle by the enemy crew. Fortunately, no one was inside at the time it was destroyed. But the charred bunks are unusable and the sight of the soot stained walls burdens your crew with the weight of their loss. 	This is an eyesore and a waste of space. Perhaps you should have this mess cleaned out while you're at the outfitter.

outfits.name: Broadband Amplifier
outfits.description: An artifact from the early era of space exploration, a Broadband Amplifier improves the range of your existing cargo and outfit scanners. However, this also increases the amount of time required to complete those scans. It is primarily found on science vessels for which maintaining a safe distance from dangerous intersellar phenomena is more relevant than quickly scanning ships for contraband or tactical information. 	This device cannot be installed on a ship that doesn't already have equipment for scanning both cargo and outfits.

outfits.name: Bunk Room (Burned)
outfits.description: This bunk room was looted and burned during a previous boarding battle by the enemy crew. Fortunately, no one was inside at the time it was destroyed. But the charred bunks are unusable and the sight of the soot stained walls burdens your crew with the weight of their loss. 	This is an eyesore and a waste of space. Perhaps you should have this mess cleaned out while you're at the outfitter.

outfits.name: D41-HY Shielding (Damaged)
outfits.description: The D41-HY Shield Generator is a more powerful shield generator designed for ships that are likely to see frequent combat, or that have such a large shield capacity that recharging them would take a long time with a smaller generator. A malfunction in this generator is causing reduced performance, excessive energy consumption, and waste heat. It also seems to be causing a slight delay before the shield regeneration process actually begins.

outfits.name: Detachable Heat Sink
outfits.description: A Detachable Heat Sink safely captures and stores excess heat as it accumulates on your ship. But it doesn't provide any actual cooling. 	Most pilots have little use for this antiquated form of heat management technology. But some outfitters still keep them in stock to satisfy a niche market of high performance pilots in search of alternative methods to manage the heat on their ships.

outfits.name: Engineering Room
outfits.description: An Engineering Room acts as a centralized control center for managing repairs and regulating the flow of energy on your ship. This can make energy usage by certain outfits more efficient while also alleviating effects that negatively impact your ship. A skilled engineering crew who understands how these systems work and interact with each other is essential to Engineering Room operations. 	Engineering Rooms are also often the location where a ship's self-destruct sequence is activated. Typically it involves deliberately causing a reactor meltdown in the ship's power systems or some similar catastrophic failure. At a minimum, this usually requires the cooperation of both the captain and the engineering crew.

outfits.name: Fuel Canister
outfits.description: A Fuel Canister increases your fuel capacity slightly. It's not enough to make a hyperspace jump, but can provide extra reserves for an afterburner.

outfits.name: Fuel Canister (Reinforced)
outfits.description: Due to variances in atmospheric pressure, reinforced Fuel Canisters were developed for harvesting gases from gas giants. Once brought to a controlled environment, the harvested gas could be refined and transferred to regular Fuel Pods for transport. 	Although this carries less fuel than a regular Fuel Canister, it has a thicker armored casing that protects against leaks.

outfits.name: Fuel Pod (Reinforced)
outfits.description: Due to variances in atmospheric pressure, reinforced Fuel Pods were developed for harvesting gases from gas giants. Once brought to a controlled environment, the harvested gas could be refined and transferred to regular Fuel Pods for transport. 	Although this carries less fuel than a regular Fuel Pod, it has a thicker armored casing that protects against leaks.

outfits.name: Fuel Tank
outfits.description: A Fuel Tank increases your fuel capacity greatly, enough to power a Scramdrive for one additional hyperspace jump.

outfits.name: Fuel Tank (Reinforced)
outfits.description: Due to variances in atmospheric pressure, reinforced Fuel Tanks were developed for harvesting gases from gas giants. Once brought to a controlled environment, the harvested gas could be refined and transferred to regular Fuel Tanks for transport. 	Although this carries less fuel than a regular Fuel Tank, it has a thicker armored casing that protects against leaks.

outfits.name: Hull Repair Equipment
outfits.description: Equipment designed to fix the hull of a ship while it is still in operation. This includes the actual repair tools as well as diagnostic equipment and environmental suits for accessing external areas of the ship. 	Before hull repairs can begin there is a delay while the crew analyzes the damage to determine how to fix it.

outfits.name: Industrial Ramscoop
outfits.description: An Industrial Ramscoop is often used to supplement deuterium harvesting operations on space stations. It's bulkier than a regular ramscoop but is able to process hyperspace fuel more efficiently.

outfits.name: Infiltrator Tech
outfits.description: The Infiltrator has this specialized scan interference and radar jamming technology integrated into the hull. It also features an optical jamming feature that causes the shields to shimmer in a way that helps the ship blend in with starry backgrounds. Data on its inner workings is classified information not available to the general public.

outfits.name: Limit Breaker
outfits.description: This outfit is sometimes referred to as the "Berserker Circuit" after the first ship it was used in. Many consider the development of this device a reckless attempt to push a ship's combat abilities to its maximum limits. But installing a Limit Breaker on your ship allows it to keep functioning well past the point that it would be disabled due to internal safety mechanisms shutting your systems down. 	Installing more than one of these outfits reduces their effectiveness as they interfere with each other as well as your ship's internal safety shutdown systems.

outfits.name: Liquid Metal Hull
outfits.description: Made with Korath nanomachine technology. Its ability to regenerate itself is unparalleled. 	This hull can reshape itself, making it compatible with a variety of hull technologies.

outfits.name: Modified D14-RN Shielding
outfits.description: The D14-RN Shield Generator is the standard shield generator for fighters and interceptors, as well as for many non-combat starships. Although it is possible for a ship to have no shield generator at all, recharging its shield matrix only when landed in a hospitable spaceport, life in deep space is unpredictable enough that most pilots find shield generators to be well worth the space they take up. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D23-QP Shielding
outfits.description: The D23-QP Shield Generator is a slightly more powerful shield generator than the standard model installed in most small ships. If combat lasts long enough, the increased recharge rate is enough to give you an edge, but recharging your shields completely will still take a long time. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D41-HY Shielding
outfits.description: The D41-HY Shield Generator is a more powerful shield generator designed for ships that are likely to see frequent combat, or that have such a large shield capacity that recharging them would take a long time with a smaller generator. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D67-TM Shielding
outfits.description: The D67-TM Shield Generator is powerful enough that in combat against some particularly weak ships, they may not even be capable of depleting your shields as fast as they recharge. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified D94-YV Shielding
outfits.description: The D94-YV Shield Generator is the most powerful shield generator available in human space. Because of their large size, D94-YV shield generators are mostly used in large warships, but you can fit one in a smaller ship if you are willing to sacrifice engine power or weaponry to make space for it. 	Modifications to this outfit have increased its rate of shield generation. However it consumes considerably more energy while also generating heat as a result of being pushed to perform beyond the intended specifications it was designed for. Note that these after market alterations voids the manufacturer's warranty.

outfits.name: Modified Hyperdrive
outfits.description: This hyperdrive has been modified to be more fuel efficient, allowing a ship to conserve fuel for long journeys. 	Rumors speculate that these Modified Hyperdrives are artifacts discovered in alien ruins on a planet in the Northern Frontier. There's no evidence to support such claims, but the list of humans who understand the inner workings of the hyperdrive is short and none of them have stepped forward to take credit for creating this.

outfits.name: Modified Jammer
outfits.description: This device has been altered to interfere with scanners. While less effective at jamming radar tracking systems, this is primarily used as a professional smuggler's tool. Most security inspectors lack the technical expertise to distinguish between this and a normal radar jammer.

outfits.name: North Wind Cooling
outfits.description: An advanced air duct cooling system developed by North Wind. While bulkier than the industry standard cooling ducts, this new system offers additional emergency cooling if the ship starts to overheat.

outfits.name: Prototype D122-ZX Shielding
outfits.description: The Prototype D122-ZX Shielding from Deep Sky is a next generation shield generator under development in human space. Larger than the the D94-YV Shield Generator, it boasts a shield generation rate beyond anything Deep Sky has ever produced. 	This experimental generator draws immense energy while producing a massive amount of waste heat, reminiscent of the modified generators sometimes used by pirates.

outfits.name: Prototype T88-AO Shielding
outfits.description: Inspired by observations of Quarg technology, the Prototype T88-AO Shielding from Tarazed is a test model generator used for experiments in human space. Larger than anything sold at regular outfitters, it pushes the limits of shield generation technology. 	This experimental generator draws immense energy while producing a massive amount of waste heat. It also temporarily overloads once the ship's shields have been depleted.

outfits.name: Shield Suppressor
outfits.description: Saboteurs use these devices to disrupt the shield generators on the ship it is installed on. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Small Bunk Room (Burned)
outfits.description: This bunk room was looted and burned during a previous boarding battle by the enemy crew. Fortunately, no one was inside at the time it was destroyed. But the charred bunks are unusable and the sight of the soot stained walls burdens your crew with the weight of their loss. 	This is an eyesore and a waste of space. Perhaps you should have this mess cleaned out while you're at the outfitter.

outfits.name: Smuggler's Hideaway
outfits.description: This hidden compartment, lined with a material similar to Interference Plating, helps conceal part of your cargo bay from scans and searches.

outfits.name: Spycraft Adapter
outfits.description: This is Navy technology, designed to plug into an expansion port hidden underneath a standard Navy Surveillance Pod. This boosts the power and efficiency of the pod while incurring only a minor reduction in atmostpheric scanning range.

outfits.name: Gnome Core
outfits.description: A collaboration between Deep Sky and Turner Inc. The Gnome Core is a more powerful Dwarf Core, offering an amazing amount of power in a compact generator.

outfits.name: Fission S2 Reactor
outfits.description: A collaboration between Syndicated Systems and Turner Inc. The Fission S2 offers more efficiency than the Fission Reactor with only a modest increase in size.

outfits.name: Heavy Fusion Core
outfits.description: A collaboration between Lovelace Labs and Turner Inc. The Heavy Fusion Core is a new entry in the energy generator market, using innovations in reactor design to deliver a superior fusion reactor.

outfits.name: H6 Refrigeration Module
outfits.description: As a cooling device, this prototype refrigeration module is a complete failure at preventing spoilage of food and other perishables that require cold storage. But there is another potential use for it. The energy feedback generated when it activates can be utilized for powering other systems on a ship. Despite the steam rising off of its surface, you're certain using it this way won't cause it to blow up. Probably.

outfits.name: LCT-2 Photovoltaic Rod
outfits.description: Light Conductor Technologies most successful product was also their first one: a rod extending out from the hull which cut down on the internal space requirements for installing photovoltaic panels. This lead the company to produce increasingly larger versions of the same product rather than research alternative technologies. 	This array has two photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.name: LCT-4 Photovoltaic Wand
outfits.description: The cost to benefit ratio of their weight and power output was something Light Conductor Technologies strived to improve in their later designs. Yet it was not enough to keep up with the technical advancements of their competitors. 	This array has four photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.name: LCT-6 Photovoltaic Staff
outfits.description: This was the last photovoltaic array developed by Light Conductor Technologies before the company went bankrupt. Unofficial duplicates of their products are still manufactured in some remote areas of the galaxy even though the original business no longer exists. 	This array has six photovoltaic panels mounted on it. Some of the energy collected is lost as it is transferred into the ship.

outfits.name: Modified nGVF-AA Fuel Cell
outfits.description: Fuel cells have been the cheapest and most common starship power sources since the dawn of the space era. This model produces only enough power for very small or slow ships. 	This fuel cell has been modified to store some of the energy it generates. However, it is not as efficient as a standard fuel cell of the same size.

outfits.name: Modified nGVF-BB Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This is a step up from the smallest fuel cells, providing enough energy to power a few small guns in addition to your engines. 	This fuel cell has been modified to store some of the energy it generates. However, it is not as efficient as a standard fuel cell of the same size.

outfits.name: Modified nGVF-CC Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This is a medium-sized fuel cell, designed to be sufficient for larger civilian ships and small warships while still being more affordable than the more sophisticated generator options. 	This fuel cell has been modified to store some of the energy it generates. However, it is not as efficient as a standard fuel cell of the same size.

outfits.name: Modified nGVF-DD Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This is a relatively large fuel cell. Other generators are available that produce more energy and fit into a smaller space, but they are much more expensive. As a result, large civilian ships that will not be frequently in combat often come equipped with these fuel cells. 	This fuel cell has been modified to store some of the energy it generates. However, it is not as efficient as a standard fuel cell of the same size.

outfits.name: Modified nGVF-EE Fuel Cell
outfits.description: This is the largest fuel cell available, larger than some nuclear reactors but much, much more affordable. Many captains on a tight budget are willing to put up with one of these until they can raise the money for something more efficient. 	This fuel cell has been modified to store some of the energy it generates. However, it is not as efficient as a standard fuel cell of the same size.

outfits.name: Modified RT-I Radiothermal
outfits.description: This radiothermal generator has been modified to greatly increase its energy output. But these alterations have resulted in it producing an incredibly high amount of heat. Using this can be dangerous: if allowed to overheat it can create power surges that ignite electrical fires, causing internal damage to the ship it is installed on. 	Some claim that the technique used to make these modified radiothermals originated from stolen research data regarding one of Tarazed's failed experiments. Whenever asked about this topic, the company always denies the validity of such rumors.

outfits.name: QT-800 Nucleovoltaic
outfits.description: Nucleovoltaic generators are a relatively recent generator technology that harvests energy from the decay of a radioisotope source and converts it directly into electricity. They are the most powerful generator that relies on nuclear decay instead of an active nuclear chain reaction. 	Tarazed's research into Quarg technology has had some unexpected findings. This prototype generator, for example, is able to achieve a significantly higher power output than the Nucleovoltaics produced by Deep Sky. Yet it is unable to do so consistently. Testing results reveal a pattern of energy spikes accompanying incidents when the test ship was overheating. However the reason for this has yet to be solved, baffling even Tarazed's most knowledgeable scientists.

outfits.name: TP036q Battery Pack
outfits.description: A ship can run without batteries if its generator's instantaneous power output is higher than the total energy consumption of its systems, but batteries make it possible to store up energy when it is not needed and thus to use a much smaller and cheaper generator. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: TP072q Battery Pack
outfits.description: This battery pack has more than twice the energy capacity of the most basic model, allowing your ship to engage in combat for longer periods of time before running out of energy. Some pilots have even been known to install these in lieu of any generator at all, trusting that they can reach their destination planet and recharge before running out of battery power, but that is a risky proposition. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: TP144q Battery Pack
outfits.description: This medium-sized battery pack is intended for ships that need to fire the occasional salvo of high-powered weaponry without running out of energy. As with all battery packs, relying on batteries is risky if combat lasts long enough for them to become depleted. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: TP288q Battery Pack
outfits.description: This is a large battery pack designed for ships that may occasionally have high power needs but do not want the expense or the heat associated with a more powerful ship's generator. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: TP576q Battery Pack
outfits.description: For most ships that require this much power, a larger generator makes more sense than a battery this size. However, battery packs have the advantage that they generate no heat, so some captains use them instead of powerful generators if they do not expect to be in combat frequently or for extended periods of time. 	Research on Quarg technology has enabled Tarazed to develop this higher capacity battery. Unfortunately, it becomes unstable when exposed to high temperatures, losing its ability to retain the energy stored within. Insufficient generators can result in a cascade failure that can drain other batteries.

outfits.name: Hybrid Afterburner
outfits.description: A modified afterburner that also taps into your ships batteries for additional power, providing an increased burst of speed.

outfits.name: Archaic Afterburner
outfits.description: The original manufacturer of this Archaic Afterburner has been long forgotten. However, it has been preserved in remarkably good condition for its age. 	An afterburner works by dumping hyperspace fuel into your engines and igniting it, producing a large amount of thrust. This can be very useful for dodging missiles or briefly escaping from faster opponents, but you must be careful to avoid using up so much fuel that you do not have enough left for hyperspace travel.

outfits.name: Sunracer Afterburner
outfits.description: Designed for use in racing, this afterburner draws power from your ships batteries as well as hyperspace fuel, providing an increased burst of speed.

outfits.name: Chimera Junk Thruster
outfits.description: This motley collection of spare parts has been assembled into a Junk propulsion system. This tiny thruster is suitable for very light fighters and interceptors. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Griffin Junk Thruster
outfits.description: Many frontier tinkerers with no formal education began their careers by cobbling together a Junk propulsion system. This thruster is intended for small ships and freighters. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Hippogriff Junk Thruster
outfits.description: Considering how they're manufactured, it's a technical marvel that the various parts used to construct a Junk propulsion system are functional. This thruster is suitable for smaller capital ships. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Manticore Junk Thruster
outfits.description: Finding quality propulsion systems can be difficult on some distant frontier worlds. This large thruster is a necessity on ships too heavy for smaller engines to handle. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Tarasque Junk Thruster
outfits.description: Frontier captains will resort to using Junk propulsion systems when alternative options are unavailable. This set of huge thrusters can only be installed on ships large enough to handle them. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Chimera Junk Steering
outfits.description: Junk steering systems are patchwork constructs made from the salvaged parts of other engines. This tiny engine is named after a mythical creature that had a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Griffin Junk Steering
outfits.description: Junk steering systems are patchwork constructs made from the salvaged parts of other engines. This small engine is named after a mythical creature that had the head, forepart, and wings of an eagle and the body, hind legs, and tail of a lion. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Hippogriff Junk Steering
outfits.description: Junk steering systems are patchwork constructs made from the salvaged parts of other engines. This medium sized engine is named after a mythical creature that had the foreparts of a griffin and the body of a horse. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Manticore Junk Steering
outfits.description: Junk steering systems are patchwork constructs made from the salvaged parts of other engines. This large engine is named after a mythical creature that had the head of a man, the body of a lion, and the tail of a scorpion. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Tarasque Junk Steering
outfits.description: Junk steering systems are patchwork constructs made from the salvaged parts of other engines. This huge engine is named after a mythical creature that had the head of a lion, the body of a turtle, the feet of a bear, and a serpent's tail. 	Junk engines are usually a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less efficient than plasma engines.

outfits.name: Antique Rifle
outfits.description: This rifle was in use prior to the Alpha War. While not significantly better or worse than modern rifles, collectors will pay a premium for it.

outfits.name: Blaster Pistol
outfits.description: Blaster Pistols rose to prominence as side-arms during the Alpha wars, but use charger packs instead of bullet magazines. Most manufacturers stopped producing them after the war due to increased production costs for the charger packs.

outfits.name: DFN-53 Android
outfits.description: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer. 	Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor. This defense android does little to assist with shipboard operations. Instead, it was programmed to protect the ship from hostile boarders. Unfortunately, it quickly becomes disoriented when forced to fight in unfamiliar territory, preventing it from being effective outside of your ship.

outfits.name: Dual Mod Blaster Pistols
outfits.description: A pair of rare Modified Blaster Pistols. A person could burn through a lot of charger packs with these.

outfits.name: Execution Chamber
outfits.description: This is a specially designed room which can be installed in your ship. Anyone who boards you in an attempt to take over your ship will find themselves locked in this room by the self sealing doors. A pair of small portholes allow your crew to safely sweep the chamber with weapons fire from the other side of the reinforced bulkhead.

outfits.name: Guncraft
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. This particular one is starting to show small traces of rust on it, which could impact its performance and collectability. The basic model has a well balanced grip and precision sigting, but there are rumors of Guncrafts that have been transformed into terrifying weapons by skilled gunsmiths.

outfits.name: Isochronal Laser Rifle
outfits.description: The Isochronal Laser was a failed attempt by Tarazed to recreate the Skylances installed on Quarg ships. While their engineers managed to create a powerful beam, they were unable to keep it stable. 	This miniaturized rifle version has a significantly extended battery life over other laser rifles. It also runs cooler, making it unlikely to overheat from prolonged use.

outfits.name: Medical Bay
outfits.description: A medical bay staffed by a trained doctor helps keep your crew in good health, boosting morale. When defending the ship, injured crew members will likely be brought here for treatment, often making defense of the medical bay a rallying point of interest in tense boarding battles.

Ships: Korath World Crafter (Kor Efret World Crafter)

outfits.name: Modified Blaster Pistol
outfits.description: A complex modification allows this rare version of the Blaster Pistol to fire a more powerful energy blast, but doing so will burn out the charger pack. This has created an insatiable demand for functioning charger packs.

outfits.name: Purger Rifle
outfits.description: Purger Rifles are sometimes used as part of clandestine biohazard containment protocols. They fire Euthanasia rounds which ensure a quick and painless death for anyone unfortunate enough to be infected with experimental pathogens. Each rifle comes with four additional magazines to ensure an uninterrupted dispersal of mercy. A hollow point injector attachment holds additional inoculations for virulent infestations that enter melee range.

outfits.name: Sniper Rifle
outfits.description: A single armor piercing bullet can change the course of history. A good scope helps too.

outfits.name: Security Station (Staffed)
outfits.description: This is a specially designed barricade, which can be installed in the hallways of your ship as a powerful defense against anyone who boards you in an attempt to take over your ship. 	Dedicated security staff posted at this station helps to ensure that the ship is protected during boarding battles.

outfits.name: Tactical Laser Rifle
outfits.description: The Tactical Laser Rifle adds a spare battery pack, allowing for longer combat engagements. Its sturdier frame also requires less regular maintenance and protects the internal components if the wielder opts to use this as a bludgeoning weapon. For the additional cost, these benefits are widely considered to be negligible for non-military use.

outfits.name: Miscellaneous Cargo
outfits.description: A variety of different trade goods haphazardly stuffed into a single crate...

outfits.name: Blaster Charger
outfits.description: A charger pack for a Blaster Pistol. You might win a special prize if you bring this to Bailey in the Citadelle system and survive the Puppetmaster's challenge...

outfits.name: Contraband
outfits.description: Illegal merchandise found in a smuggler's cargo bay. You might be able to sell it for a profit if the authorities haven't caught you with it first.

outfits.name: Drone Hacking
outfits.description: "How to Hack a Science Drone For Fun and Profit." This guidebook instructs the reader on how to abuse the cargo scan fining system by hacking into a drone's scanners when boarding the drone. Contrary to the title, it works on any drone set up for scanning cargo or outfits. One important detail buried in the text is that the drone must not be hostile towards you. Keep this installed on your flagship for easy reference when you find a suitable drone to hack.

outfits.name: Eureka Map
outfits.description: A map with directions to reach a specific area on Eureka Station, an old derelict in the Ipsing system. What you'll find if you go there is unknown... 	You must have this installed on your flagship in order to use it when you land at the designated location.

outfits.name: Research Data
outfits.description: A collection of data recorded from scanning interstellar phenomena, exploring alien worlds, or investigating strange technologies. Often, these discoveries lead to more questions than answers. 	This is general data covering a wide variety of sciences but specializing in none.

outfits.name: Research Data (Bio)
outfits.description: A collection of data recorded from scanning interstellar phenomena, exploring alien worlds, or investigating strange technologies. Often, these discoveries lead to more questions than answers. 	This is biology data often associated with, but not limited to, agricultural, medical, and terraforming studies.

outfits.name: Research Data (Chem)
outfits.description: A collection of data recorded from scanning interstellar phenomena, exploring alien worlds, or investigating strange technologies. Often, these discoveries lead to more questions than answers. 	This is chemistry data often associated with, but not limited to, developing weapons and various compounds.

outfits.name: Research Data (Phys)
outfits.description: A collection of data recorded from scanning interstellar phenomena, exploring alien worlds, or investigating strange technologies. Often, these discoveries lead to more questions than answers. 	This is physics data often associated with, but not limited to, graviton, quantum, and weft theory.

outfits.name: Spirit Board
outfits.description: A simple wooden plank with letters and numbers etched onto its surface, this ancient item is associated with the occult. Supposedly, it can attract the attention of entities who exist outside our mortal realm...

outfits.name: Subsidurial Plushie
outfits.description: A stuffed toy shaped like a popular space creature. Isn't it adorable? Keep this installed on your flagship to show your support for the Subsi and Friends show!

outfits.name: Syndicate Bond (Titania)
outfits.description: This bond certifies a loan to the Syndicate for one billion credits. Ten years after being issued, bond holders can reclaim the one billion credit principal plus an additional five hundred million credits interest payment at Syndicate outfitters. 	This bond was issued to fund the creation of Titania Station in the Eteron system. Once the Syndicate has enough funding for this project, these bonds will no longer be available.

outfits.name: Syndicate Stock (Common)
outfits.description: This certificate represents ownership of one share of Syndicate common stock. Common stock grants no voting power in shareholder elections, but shareholders can still receive dividend payments. 	After the destruction of the Galactic Stock Exchange, the Syndicate began buying and selling shares of their corporate common stock through outfitters on worlds under their control.

outfits.name: Alien Torture Device
outfits.description: A machine assembled from scavenged parts that appear to be alien in origin. It creates a burst of energy that causes extreme pain. While not harmful enough to kill its victims, this device can be used to torture captured defenders until they reveal the codes for bypassing a ship's internal security locks.

Missions: Ship Sale: Modified Argosy (Screams of Madness)

outfits.name: Almachian Brain Maggots
outfits.description: A jar of writhing alien worms. After one is inserted into the victim's ear, there are several moments of agonizing pain and suffering before the victim dies. While not a practical combat weapon, the threat of being tortured to death by these creatures is often enough to persuade a captured crew member to give up the security codes for bypassing the ship's internal door locks.

Missions: Ship Sale: Modified Argosy (Screams of Insanity)

outfits.name: Balthazar Model
outfits.description: A 1/100th scale model of the District ship, Balthazar. Some assembly required.

outfits.name: Biohazard Gas
outfits.description: This illegal weapon designed for hand-to-hand combat seems to have been developed through experiments using the gas produced by Pug Biodefenses on unwilling human test subjects.

outfits.name: Carabao AI
outfits.description: This computer regulates all of the automated systems on the Carabao city ship.

outfits.name: Catapult Schematics
outfits.description: The schematics for the Asteroid Catapult that was installed on the Thermopylae space battle station. Without a skilled engineer willing to actually make one, these are just pictures on a computer screen.

outfits.name: Cloaking Device (Damaged)
outfits.description: You're sure the cloaking device is here somewhere. You can't see it, but you can feel the heat it is generating.

outfits.name: CRG-0 Android
outfits.description: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer. 	Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor. This cargo android does little to assist with most shipboard operations. Instead, it was programmed to load cargo bays with a focus on making effective use of the available space, allowing more cargo to be crammed onto a ship. However, this can make retrieving a specific package more difficult than some would consider worth the effort.

outfits.name: Fake Coffin
outfits.description: This box appears to be a coffin. However its inner surface is lined with a material similar to interference plating. Only the most cold hearted investigator with a strong stomach would dare open it up to inspect the contents.

outfits.name: Guncraft I
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. This particular one has been kept in perfect condition. The basic model has a well balanced grip and precision sigting, but you've heard rumors of gunsmiths who possess the knowledge and skill to make parts modifications that could transform it into a terrifying weapon.

outfits.name: Guncraft II
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features an improved rifled barrel, increasing the weapon's range.

outfits.name: Guncraft III
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a larger magazine for more ammo.

outfits.name: Guncraft IV
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a laser guided tactical aim assist system, displaying range data while also marking the target.

outfits.name: Guncraft V
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features a magnetic rail launching system, eliminating the need for gunpowder. This requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	Mag-rail Slugs aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VI
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features heat resistant magazines as a safety precaution in case the ammunition explodes prematurely. 	Detonator Rounds aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VII
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The rumors of gunsmiths who can make parts modifications to improve upon this weapon are true! 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features an ionic resistant firing mechanism to prevent it from being affected by its own ammunition. 	Ionic Rounds aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Guncraft VIII
outfits.description: An old relic from the early turf wars, the Guncraft is considered by many to be the pinnacle of handgun design. The work of several elite weaponsmiths have turned it into a terrifying weapon... 	A magnetic rail launching system eliminates the need for gunpowder but requires the gun to be charged by your ship's systems regularly. 	This upgraded version of the Guncraft features radioactive shielding to protect the wielder from its ammunition. 	Atomic Bullets aren't sold in shops, requiring you to modify regular bullets instead. This adds a small operating cost to the Guncraft to ensure you have a steady supply of ammunition.

outfits.name: Leviathan Comic
outfits.description: The first issue of Drugub's comic book inspired by human ship designs. The art looks good, but you can't read Arach.

outfits.name: Leviathan Comic #1
outfits.description: The first issue of Drugub's comic book inspired by human ship designs. The art looks good, but you can't read Arach. After a decade, this has become a rare collector's item.

outfits.name: Lionheart Sponsorship
outfits.description: As part of your sponsorship agreement, Lionheart Industries will pay 500 credits per day when you use this ship. 	(Operating income will not be paid while this ship is parked.)

outfits.name: Melchior Post Card
outfits.description: An old fashioned post card with a photo depicting Melchior on the day it was launched from the Old Port on Zug.

outfits.name: Microwave Cannon
outfits.description: Papa Grudge's custom weapon. It emits a cone of blistering heat, making it difficult for the enemy to maintain a defensive position. While not immediately lethal, prolonged exposure can cause blindness, disfigurement, and ultimately leads to a slow and agonizing death. This sort of weapons modification violates several consumer safety laws and regulations, so don't expect to find one of these for sale at any legitimate outfitter.

outfits.name: Skeleton Key
outfits.description: Urban legends include tales of three "Skeleton Keys" that unlock a pirate treasure. Perhaps this is one of those legendary keys.

outfits.name: Syndicate Stock (Preferred)
outfits.description: This certificate represents ownership of one share of Syndicate preferred stock. As a preferred shareholder, you have voting power in shareholder elections. 	Shares of Syndicate preferred stock are no longer available for purchase. The last batch was issued over 200 years ago. The Syndicate still disburses dividends for existing shares owned by those fortunate enough to have them.

outfits.name: T.H.O.R.
outfits.description: Produced by Kraz Cybernetics, this prototype Tactical Heavy Offensive Robot is armed with a tactical laser rifle, a shoulder mounted gatling gun, and an arm mounted pile driver. An installable storage bay for charging, maintenance, and repairs is included. Combat testing of the artificial intelligence is incomplete and the mass production design has not yet been finalized. Therefore pre-orders are not being accepted at this time. When this is installed on a ship, a dedicated maintenance crew must be hired for it.

outfits.name: T.H.O.R. (Damaged)
outfits.description: Produced by Kraz Cybernetics, this prototype Tactical Heavy Offensive Robot has taken severe damage. The engineers on Rust in the Kraz system can probably repair it, but it won't be cheap. Although it is not able to be deployed, you should keep this installed on your ship to prevent it from being mixed in with the regular cargo.

outfits.name: Crystal Key
outfits.description: Han Sizer purportedly acquired this object from a Quarg he encountered in the Outer Rim. Supposedly it is a key that can open a path to far flung regions of the galaxy that would otherwise be inaccessible to humanity. 	In all his travels, Han never found the door. Or perhaps he did but never shared the knowledge of what lay beyond. Most scholars familiar with the tale have concluded that some, if not all, aspects of this story are completely fabricated.

outfits.name: Deep Security License
outfits.description: That's classified.

outfits.name: Covert Mining License
outfits.description: This proves that you've been granted permission to purchase ships and outfits exclusively reserved for members of the Covert Mining Cartel and their esteemed associates.

outfits.name: Fake Pilot's License
outfits.description: This Pilot's License is a forgery. Most people won't notice, but it might set off some alarms if it is detected in a scan by Republic authorities. 	If you ever acquire a real Pilot's License, you'll automatically dispose of this one the next time you fly.

outfits.name: Inferno Dragon License
outfits.description: This secret poem is the key to access Inferno Rockets at pirate outfitters across the galaxy: 	The Inferno Dragon's claws ravage the timeless earth. 	The Inferno Dragon's presence causes all to tremble. 	The Inferno Dragon's breath boils the boundless ocean. 	The Inferno Dragon's thirst can never be quenched. 	The Inferno Dragon's wings spread across the endless sky. 	The Inferno Dragon's ambition reaches the heavens.

outfits.name: Sunracer License
outfits.description: Only pilots who've proven their skills in a timed Sunracer Qualifier can participate in Solus League races. 	Solus League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 250 tons.

outfits.name: Solus Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Solus League race qualifies a racer to participate in Geminae League races. 	Geminae League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 200 tons.

outfits.name: Geminae Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Geminae League race qualifies a racer to participate in Tertio League races. 	Tertio League races require a ship to have no crew other than the pilot and weigh less than 150 tons.

outfits.name: Tertio Champion License
outfits.description: Winning first place in a Tertio League race is the highest honor a Sunracer can aspire to. 	Tertio Champions are sometimes offered jobs and opportunities not available to other racing pilots.

outfits.name: Fake Pilot's License Token
outfits.description: The Fake Pilot's License is a proxy for this outfit because the game does not include licenses in outfit scans.

outfits.name: Geminae Token
outfits.description: Grants access to Checkpoint Geminae.

outfits.name: Solus Token
outfits.description: Grants access to Checkpoint Solus.

outfits.name: Tertio Token
outfits.description: Grants access to Checkpoint Tertio.

outfits.name: Double Anti-Missile Turret
outfits.description: The Double Anti-Missile Turret fills the role of a medium weight anti-missile weapon. Its high rate of fire makes it an ideal choice for thinning out missile swarms.

outfits.name: Energy Cannon
outfits.description: A relic from the Alpha War, Energy Cannons fell into disuse once the war ended. Occasionally they can still be found outfitted on older ships. They are more powerful than Energy Blasters, but their rate of fire is slower and the effectiveness of the projectiles diminishes the more distant the target.

outfits.name: Energy Cannon Turret
outfits.description: The turreted version of the Energy Cannon consists of a single Energy Cannon mounted onto a rotating base. If there is any one factor that lead to the decline of this weapon, it might be the relatively slow turret turn rate which made it difficult to aim at fighters that were growing increasingly nimble as newer designs were developed.

outfits.name: Isochronal Laser
outfits.description: The Isochronal Laser was a failed attempt by Tarazed to recreate the Skylances installed on Quarg ships. While their engineers managed to create a powerful beam, they were unable to keep it stable. 	These were never adopted for widespread use and Tarazed was eventually forced to stop production of them due to poor sales. Ships in the South can sometimes be found with these rare weapons installed. However the vast majority of Isochronal Lasers are still held by Tarazed itself.

outfits.name: Isochronal Laser Turret
outfits.description: The Isochronal Laser was a failed attempt by Tarazed to recreate the Skylances installed on Quarg ships. While their engineers managed to create a powerful beam, they were unable to keep it stable. 	This turreted version of the Isochronal Laser appeals to a very niche market of pilots who want an upgrade to Deep Sky's Laser Turret, but lack the space for Heavy Lasers on their ships.

outfits.name: Junk Tractor
outfits.description: Junk Tractors provide worse performance in just about every aspect than other Tractor Beams, but that's probably because they're made from salvaged parts or are missing a few components. The latter might explain why they require less space...

outfits.name: Kludge Blaster
outfits.description: Kludge Blasters started out as a failed attempt at modifying an Energy Blaster. Despite their shady origins, the most basic version eventually gained widespread popularity as a budget alternative mining weapon and are available at many legitimate outfitters across the galaxy. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Twin Kludge Blaster
outfits.description: Pirate captains short on cash due to botched raid attempts or an unlucky night at the card tables might resort to mounting Kludge Blasters onto their ship instead of more effective weapons. Jamming two Kludge Blasters into a single gun port was one innovation that spawned copycats among other blaster designers. The localized cluster fire exhibited in them harkens back to this original design. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Triple Kludge Blaster
outfits.description: The pressures of war inspired weaponsmiths to figure out how to squeeze even more Kludge Blasters into a single gun port. This increases the damage yield at the cost of increased heat buildup. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Kludge Blaster Turret
outfits.description: Pirate captains short on cash due to smuggling jobs gone wrong, or an unlucky run at the dog races might resort to mounting Kludge Blasters onto their ship instead of more effective weapons. Unlike other blaster turrets, both barrels of the Kludge Blaster Turret fire simultaneously. It was hoped that launching the projectiles in a volley would help compensate for the weapon's slow rate of fire. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Quad Kludge Blaster Turret
outfits.description: While the Kludge Blaster is considered a poor man's weapon among pirates, tinkerers continue to see potential in connecting several of them together. All four Kludge Blasters mounted on this turret fire at the same time, launching a deadly volley of projectiles towards the target. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Hex Kludge Blaster Turret
outfits.description: Overzealous weaponsmiths crafted this arrangement of six Kludge Blasters clustered onto a single turret mount. This increases the damage yield at the cost of increased heat buildup. As with other Kludge Blaster configurations, all six fire at the same time, launching a deadly volley of projectiles towards the target. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Modified Plasma Turret
outfits.description: This Plasma Turret only has a single Plasma Cannon mounted on it. While not as fearsome as Kraz's Plasma Turret, it is far more accessible.

outfits.name: Plunder Beam
outfits.description: The Plunder Beam is favored by the Covert Mining Cartel for its superiority in a tug of war against other miners. It has a few quirks, such as a shorter range than regular Tractor Beams and high heat output.

outfits.name: Twin Particle Cannon
outfits.description: Both barrels of the Twin Particle Cannon fire simultaneously, releasing double the force of a single Particle Cannon all at once. The size of this weapon is its main drawback, as few ships can accommodate it. While this product is fully functional, the sales department has raised concerns about its viability in the marketplace. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Particle Burst Turret
outfits.description: One of the most frequent product requests submitted to Lovelace Labs is for a turreted version of the Particle Cannon. While none have made it past the prototype testing phase before, this version looks promising. 	An issue with previous designs was jamming in the turret turning mechanism due to stress from the recoil. In addition to a reinforced turret mount, the Particle Burst Turret limits the rate of fire to a three shot burst. Lab results have been satisfactory so far, but actual combat testing is needed. 	This weapon is still in development and is unavailable to the general public. A few lucky pilots with connections within the company have been given access to prototypes for field testing.

outfits.name: Plasma Charge Cannon
outfits.description: The Plasma Charge Cannon has been modified to take advantage of concentrated firing mounts. The power and range of each shot has increased at the expense of increasing the weapon's charge up time and the projectile destabilizing at extreme distances. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Proton Gun-CF8
outfits.description: Four out of five reviewers at Stars and Starships Magazine criticized the Proton Gun-CF8 as a blatant marketing gimmick meant to appeal to Vanguard aficionados. The lone dissenting review praised the aesthetic appeal of its projectile firing pattern. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Proton Turret-ATS
outfits.description: The Syndicate Proton Turret-ATS was designed for the cost conscious captain concerned about keeping crew wages under control. No gunner is required to operate this turret. Instead, aiming is accomplished by utilizing an advanced automated targeting system which has been in development for several years. Critics note it has lower accuracy and response times than a skilled human gunner. Despite this, some captains consider the trade off worthwhile.

outfits.name: Prototype Anti-Missile
outfits.description: This Prototype Anti-Missile requires a crewmember to manually aim and fire the turret. It was more effective than most other attempts at early anti-missile systems, which were slow to reload and rarely hit their target.

outfits.name: Silencer Beam
outfits.description: A specialized weapon used by Republic Intelligence operatives, the Silencer Beam is optimized for disabling ships instead of destroying them. This comes at the cost of increased heat accumulation.

outfits.name: Spotlight
outfits.description: This powerful light source can be installed into one of your ship's gun ports. Some miners insist that using a Spotlight to visually inspect asteroids while they work helps them improve their yield by reducing waste. 	Despite doing no damage, targeting other ships with this can still provoke them...

outfits.name: Search Light
outfits.description: A Spotlight mounted onto a rotating turret platform provides a wider area of coverage. Whether or not this can help you locate anything lurking in the darkness is uncertain. 	Despite doing no damage, targeting other ships with this can still provoke them...

outfits.name: Tri Laser Turret
outfits.description: The Tri Laser Turret was an early attempt to produce a more powerful laser turret. Deep Sky abandoned it with the development of the Heavy Laser.

outfits.name: Turbo Blaster
outfits.description: A new form of Modified Energy Blaster, the Turbo Blaster has been further modified to increase its rate of fire. The result is an incredibly powerful weapon. The heat from this blaster can accumulate quickly, especially when used in multiples. 	These weapons first appeared on pirate ships in the Dirt Belt and may hint at hidden pirate bases in the area.

outfits.name: Twin Turbo Blaster
outfits.description: The Twin Turbo Blaster's high rate of fire is capable of launching four projectiles before other twin blasters can fire their second volley. The heat generated from firing both barrels at once is considerable. 	These weapons first appeared on pirate ships in the Dirt Belt and may hint at hidden pirate bases in the area.

outfits.name: Turbo Blaster Turret
outfits.description: This is a turreted version of the Turbo Blaster, which is a Modified Energy Blaster enhanced with an increased rate of fire. These mounted blasters can cover a 360 degree arc with double the fire power of a single Turbo Blaster. 	These weapons first appeared on pirate ships in the Dirt Belt and may hint at hidden pirate bases in the area.

outfits.name: Quad Turbo Blaster Turret
outfits.description: The combined firepower of the four Turbo Blasters mounted on this turret matches more powerful weapons through sheer overwhelming numbers of projectiles. However, the internal heat generated from this weapon may be more than some ships can handle. 	These weapons first appeared on pirate ships in the Dirt Belt and may hint at hidden pirate bases in the area.

outfits.name: Quad Mod Blaster Turret
outfits.description: Four Modified Blasters mounted on a turret base provide double the firepower of a regular Modified Blaster Turret, but also double the heat generated and energy consumed.

outfits.name: Metallic Asteroid
outfits.description: The most difficult part of operating an Asteroid Catapult is locating ammunition with the right size, shape, density, and magnetic properties.

outfits.name: Asteroid Storage
outfits.description: This box of rocks holds extra asteroids for the Asteroid Catapult. Since it's basically a cargo container, it occupies your cargo hold rather than your ship's outfit systems. Three crewmembers are needed to transport the asteroids from the ship's cargo bay to the catapult and load it.

outfits.name: Asteroid Catapult
outfits.description: This is basically a large rail gun that uses exotic ammunition. Unfortunately, development of asteroid based weapons systems was banned in the Republic, Syndicate, and Free Worlds due to an unexpected development in the field of terraforming.

outfits.name: Hyperspace Nuke
outfits.description: This Nuclear Missile has been outfitted with an experimental hyperspace fuel afterburner. It can fly faster, and potentially, farther than standard Nuclear Missiles if it doesn't explode prematurely from the hull stress. This increased speed helps it outpace anti-missile systems, but it has difficulty adjusting its trajectory once fired. 	[Hyperspace nukes are a one-shot weapon: each missile occupies a gun slot, and after it is fired, the slot it was in is left empty.]

outfits.name: Inferno Rocket
outfits.description: Inferno Rockets are ammunition for the Inferno Rocket Launcher. You cannot install one unless you have first installed a launcher to fire it from. Each launcher holds up to 20 rockets.

outfits.name: Inferno Rocket Rack
outfits.description: The Inferno Rocket Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Inferno Rocket Launchers.

outfits.name: Inferno Rocket Depot
outfits.description: The Inferno Rocket Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Inferno Rockets. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Inferno Rocket Launcher
outfits.description: A weapon secretly developed through cooperation between different pirate factions, Inferno Rockets splatter their targets with a highly flammable substance.

outfits.name: Inferno Rocket Pod
outfits.description: A weapon secretly developed through cooperation between different pirate factions, Inferno Rockets splatter their targets with a highly flammable substance. 	Pods enable fighters and other light craft to carry small quantities of rockets into battle while retaining enough space for other weapons. Large ships are better off with full-size launchers.

outfits.name: Plasma Missile
outfits.description: A Plasma Missile serves as ammunition for the Plasma Missile Launcher. Each missile launcher has its own capacity; you cannot install missiles if you have not first purchased a pod, launcher, or storage to store them in.

outfits.name: Plasma Missile Box
outfits.description: The Plasma Missile Box is used to store extra ammunition for Plasma Missile Launchers.

outfits.name: Plasma Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Plasma Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Plasma Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Plasma Missile Launcher
outfits.description: Kraz Cybernetics' Plasma Missile is an update to the ubiquitous Meteor. While still vulnerable to anti-missile systems, their infrared tracking is able to home in on targets that have already had their heat levels raised by previous strikes from Plasma Cannons, other Plasma Missiles, or similar weaponry.

outfits.name: Plasma Missile Pod
outfits.description: Kraz Cybernetics' Plasma Missile is an update to the ubiquitous Meteor. While still vulnerable to anti-missile systems, their infrared tracking is able to home in on targets that have already had their heat levels raised by previous strikes from Plasma Cannons, other Plasma Missiles, or similar weaponry. 	Pods enable fighters and other light craft to carry small quantities of missiles into battle while retaining enough space for other weapons. Large ships are better off with full-size launchers.

outfits.name: Plunder Mine
outfits.description: This is ammunition for the Plunder Catapult. Typically the these consist of eight sturdy iron crates filled with pressure triggered explosives, loaded onto a pallet. 	The practice of spray painting the sides of the crates to differentiate them from normal cargo was quickly adopted when pirate captains noticed their crews would sometimes load the wrong crates into the catapult.

outfits.name: Plunder Depot
outfits.description: Pirates never developed fancy storage solutions for Plunder Mines beyond designating some cargo space for them and assigning a crew member to maintain inventory. 	If you run out of cargo space and want to carry more Plunder Mines, install a Cargo Expansion to make room for another Plunder Depot.

outfits.name: Plunder Catapult
outfits.description: Favored by smugglers, this weapon jettisons crates loaded with explosives to lure unwary pursuers into a deadly trap. 	These mines bypass shields by detonating as enemy ships try to load them into their cargo bays. They can be dangerous to the ship deploying them if they detonate before they've had a chance to disperse.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile
outfits.description: A Stinger Missile serves as ammunition for the Stinger Missile Launcher. You cannot install missiles if you have not first purchased a pod, launcher, or rack to store them in. 	Mass produced under horrendous conditions on pirate worlds, Stinger Missiles utilize outdated radar tracking technology and are also easily destroyed by anti-missile weapons. Often, the slaves assigned to manufacture them are sick or elderly. In other words, the ones too weak to fight or have low potential future value. Accidental exposure to the toxic materials in these weapons during construction is common, resulting in a high mortality rate among the laborers.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Rack
outfits.description: The Stinger Missile Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Stinger Missile Launchers.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Stinger Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Stinger Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Launcher
outfits.description: The use of hazardous waste as a weapon has long been a popular tactic among anarchists and terrorists. Stinger Missiles are an insidious example of this. Developed during the early turf wars, the materials to make them are readily available and there is no shortage of suppliers. 	Once it splatters the target with its dangerous payload, the residue will continue to discharge the shields or corrode the hull for some time after the initial impact.

outfits.name: Stinger Missile Pod
outfits.description: The use of hazardous waste as a weapon has long been a popular tactic among anarchists and terrorists. Stinger Missiles are an insidious example of this. Developed during the early turf wars, the materials to make them are readily available and there is no shortage of suppliers. 	Once it splatters the target with its dangerous payload, the residue will continue to discharge the shields or corrode the hull for some time after the initial impact. 	Pods enable fighters and other light craft to carry small quantities of rockets into battle while retaining enough space for other weapons. Large ships are better off with full-size launchers.

outfits.name: Swingfire Missile
outfits.description: The Swingfire Missile is ammunition for the Swingfire Missile Launcher. You cannot install missiles if you have not first purchased a pod, launcher, or rack to store them in.

outfits.name: Swingfire Missile Rack
outfits.description: The Swingfire Missile Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Swingfire Missile Launchers.

outfits.name: Swingfire Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Swingfire Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Swingfire Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Swingfire Missile Launcher
outfits.description: An upgrade from Lovelace Labs popular Sidewinders, the Swingfire Missile is equipped with additional maneuvering thrusters and an enhanced targeting system. After being launched, it will recalculate a target's trajectory relative to its original position before activating its main rocket to pursue it. This increases the missile's accuracy while extending its range.

outfits.name: Swingfire Missile Pod
outfits.description: An upgrade from Lovelace Labs popular Sidewinders, the Swingfire Missile is equipped with additional maneuvering thrusters and an enhanced targeting system. After being launched, it will recalculate a target's trajectory relative to its original position before activating its main rocket to pursue it. This increases the missile's accuracy while extending its range. 	Pods enable fighters and other light craft to carry small quantities of missiles into battle while retaining enough space for other weapons. Large ships are better off with full-size launchers.

outfits.name: Thermo Detonator
outfits.description: WARNING: This device is a one-shot weapon. It will destroy your ship when detonated. A security override prevents activation unless hostiles are nearby. 	It should be noted that any evidence suggesting this outfit was installed on your ship at the time of its destruction voids any insurance policy that would have paid compensation otherwise. 	This outfit is integrated into your ship's hull and cannot be safely removed without damaging it.

outfits.name: Meteor Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Meteor Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Meteor Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Twin Meteor Launcher
outfits.description: The Meteor Missile is the cheapest and simplest homing weapon available in human space, with only rudimentary infrared tracking systems that can have trouble homing in on targets with low heat levels. True to its name, the missile reaches a very high speed to leave its target's anti-missile defenses with little time to react. The trade-off is maneuverability, so Meteor Missiles are practically useless against agile targets farther than point-blank range. 	This alternative to the Meteor Missile Launcher was in common use centuries ago. With the widespread adoption of Torpedo technology, the Twin Meteor Launcher is considered an antiquated design. 	This weapon will jam if there isn't enough ammunition to fire a full volley.

outfits.name: Torpedo Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Torpedo Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Twin Torpedo Pod
outfits.description: Torpedoes are the most powerful homing weapon, but they move slowly enough that fast ships can simply outrun them, making them most useful against large targets or against small ships at times when they are too distracted to dodge. 	At first glance this looks like a regular Torpedo Launcher. But a closer inspection reveals that these are a pair of Torpedo Pods jury rigged to be crammed into a single gunport. Both are programmed to activate simultaneously, launching a pair of Torpedoes when fired. 	This weapon will jam if there isn't enough ammunition to fire a full volley.

outfits.name: Sidewinder Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Sidewinder Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Sidewinder Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.description: The Javelin Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Javelins. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. outfits.name: Typhoon Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Typhoon Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Typhoon Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.description: The Heavy Rocket Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Heavy Rockets. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. outfits.name: Bullet Box Depot
outfits.description: The Bullet Box Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Gatling Gun Ammo. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.description: The Plasma Charge Cannon has been modified to take advantage of concentrated firing mounts. The power and range of each shot has increased at the expense of increasing the weapon's charge up time. 	This weapon is set to fire in "cluster" mode, synchronizing its rate of fire when multiple copies are installed together.

outfits.name: Ammo Basics
outfits.description: "How Not To Blow Yourself Up: A Guide To Ammunition Development." 	This guidebook gives novice weapons developers safety tips and best practices for experimenting with ammunition. A small disclaimer indicates that this is for informational purposes only. The publisher accepts no liability for any damage, injury, or death resulting from anyone reading this book. 	Keep this installed on your flagship if you want to research ammunition technologies as you fly through the galaxy.

outfits.name: Ammo Expertise License
outfits.description: You have learned all of the basic human ammunition technologies. Perhaps this foundational knowledge might prove useful in your research endeavors. 	You must still carry a copy of Ammo Basics if you want to research new ammunition technologies.

outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Meteor Missiles.
