outfits.name: Deflection Beam
outfits.description: The Deflection Beam is a variation of the Incipias' Stagnation Beam. During the time that Pon'tes was under construction this device was originally developed to stop a rogue asteroid from continuing its deadly trajectory towards a collision with the space station. Hicemus tacticians have recently concluded that this application of tractor technology could create new tactical options in space combat. 	The secret of how these beams work is only known to a few scientists of the Incipias who are under the control of the state. Such knowledge, if made public, could have disastrous consequences for the Hicemus and their grip on power.

outfits.name: Midnight FTL Prototype
outfits.description: An experimental FTL drive. It is not clear how this is activated...

outfits.name: Builder Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Builders anti-missile technology isn't much more advanced than what is available from Lovelace Labs. In some ways they're inferior. Their range is severely limited and they have a slow recharge time. Also, these turrets require a crew member to operate them.

outfits.name: Builder Negator
outfits.description: A rapid fire version of the Nullifier, the Negator is so powerful that it impacts the ship it is installed on with some ionic interference. If not used with discretion, it can easily drain its own ship's power reserves and even cause its own internal mechanisms to jam. 	Attempts to train the Ka'het to use this weapon ended with disastrous results. They possessed no sense of restraint, constantly firing the Negator until their own energy storage systems ran dry.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Cooling
outfits.description: This powerful cooling system keeps large Builder ships from overheating.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Defense
outfits.description: Builder ships had weak shields, which necessitated development of strong hulls and hull repair technologies. Devices like the Grand Defense are a rarity, as the Builders only intended them to supplement the integrated hull repair on their largest ships.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Generator
outfits.description: The most powerful generator created by the Builders, the Grand Generator is reserved for installation on the largest of Builder ships.

outfits.name: Builder Grand Accumulator
outfits.description: A bank of power accumulators condensed to store vast amounts of energy for use on larger Builder ships.

outfits.name: Builder Hull Plating (100%)
outfits.description: Builder capital ships have extremely durable hulls. This enhanced hull plating allows a ship it is installed on to survive diving into the harsh atmosphere of a gas giant even if it wasn't specifically designed to do so. Relying on this too often will cause it to deteriorate.

outfits.name: Ka'het Cloak Armor (20%)
outfits.description: This special hull plating can enhance the cloaking abilty of Ka'het that have the ability to do so. It could also allow the Ka'het it is installed on to survive diving into the harsh atmosphere of a gas giant. However, doing so will cause it to deteriorate.

outfits.name: Ka'het Cloak Armor (10%)
outfits.description: This special hull plating can enhance the cloaking abilty of Ka'het that have the ability to do so. It can also allow the Ka'het it is installed on to survive diving into the harsh atmosphere of a gas giant. However, doing so will definitely destroy it.

outfits.name: Ka'het Tactical Armor (30%)
outfits.description: Ka'het Tactical Armor is designed to facilitate evading enemy weapons fire. This can also allow the Ka'het it is installed on to survive diving into the harsh atmosphere of a gas giant. Relying on this too often will cause it to deteriorate.

outfits.name: Builder IFF (Damaged)
outfits.description: Normally, this would give you access to restricted areas of the Builder space stations, but this particular unit is damaged.

outfits.name: Builder IFF Transmitter
outfits.description: This device is able to transmit codes which give you access to certain restricted areas of the Builder space stations.

outfits.name: Ka'het Scanner
outfits.description: A powerful scanner outfitted onto the Ka'het to gather information on hostile alien species. The Builders never envisioned it being used to gather information on themselves. 	The Ka'het scanner is incredibly sensitive, but the materials used in its construction can act as a lightning rod, making your ship more vulnerable to the effects of ionization.

outfits.name: Graveyard Map
outfits.description: A map of the graveyard found aboard the Omnipotence. Several systems are marked.

outfits.name: Blaze-Pike
outfits.description: Exile weapon design research stumbled upon an enexpected discovery when firing multiple Fire-Lances in close proximity. With just the right arrangement, it is possible to merge their beams into a single longer stream of fire that burns hotter than they would individually.

outfits.name: Inferno-Trident
outfits.description: Adding another Fire-Lance to the Blaze-Pike was a natural next step in Exile weapon design research. Mounting three them together in this array allows them to operate synergistically, creating an even longer, more powerful beam than the Blaze-Pike.

outfits.name: Scavenger Turret
outfits.description: Some Korath Exiles still use these antiquated devices in their efforts to scavenge for raw materials. An early implementation of Korath grav-ray technology, the power of the beam is greater than human equivalents, but is still not strong enough to move anything larger than cargo crates or similar flotsam.

outfits.name: Shock-Strike Turret
outfits.description: Korath Grab-Strike projectiles are designed to pull a target closer to the Korath ship, to keep it from escaping. 	This weapon adds an ionic charge to the Grab-Strike projectiles, further incapacitating the targeted ship.

outfits.name: Thermal Obliterator
outfits.description: A rare sight in the Korath arsenal, Thermal Obliterators need authorization from multiple planning committees before resources can be allocated to the construction of one. 	This weapon launches huge globs of super heated plasma that can obliterate smaller ships with a single strike. As with other thermal weapons developed by the Korath, this attack requires a lengthy cooldown period before the weapon can fire again.

outfits.name: Thermal Scorcher
outfits.description: The Thermal Scorcher is an antiquated weapon that predates the Korath civil war. It fires a large glob of super heated plasma at the target. This brutal attack generates an incredible amount of heat, requiring a significant cooldown period before the weapon can fire again.

outfits.name: Thermal Scorcher Turret
outfits.description: Only a single Thermal Scorcher is mounted on this turret. They are a rare sight now, but during the Korath civil war battleships bristling with these sorts of armaments were  common.

outfits.name: Magnetic Mine
outfits.description: This is ammunition for a Magnetic Mine Deployer. 	Development of this weapon was rushed to deployment at the request of Navarchs who have explored the Ember Wastes.

outfits.name: Magnetic Mine Rack
outfits.description: The Magnetic Mine Rack is used to store extra ammunition for a Magnetic Mine Deployer. 	These storage racks also act as a faraday cage to prevent the stored mines from accidentally interfering with the generators of the ship while carrying them.

outfits.name: Magnetic Mine Depot
outfits.description: The Magnetic Mine Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Magnetic Mines. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Magnetic Mine Deployer
outfits.description: Development of the Magnetic Mine Deployer is the result of lessons learned from the Korath's previous encounters in the Ember Waste and Graveyard. 	This new mine does less damage overall than the old Cluster Mines, but also emits electromagnetic pulses which interferes with the generators of enemy ships caught within its blast radius.

outfits.name: Piercer Missile Depot
outfits.description: The Piercer Missile Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Piercer Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Cluster Mine Depot
outfits.description: The Cluster Mine Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Cluster Mines. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Firelight Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Firelight Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Firelight Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Firestorm Torpedo Depot
outfits.description: The Firestorm Torpedo Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Firestorm Torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Microbot Corroder
outfits.description: Vindictive Korath boarding crews will attach this to the hull of an enemy ship. The Microbot Corroder creates microbots programmed to break down the hull of the ship it's installed on into raw materials which are then used to create more microbots. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Botanical Garden
outfits.description: Some Korath World-Ships are outfitted with the necessary equipment to maintain artificial biomes stocked with an assortment of biological samples from their destroyed worlds. 	This Botanical Garden is a collection of trees, plants, and other vegetation that can be used for a variety of purposes including conservation, research, and food production.  However, your crew and passengers are your best customers. 	In addition to outfit space, this production outfit requires cargo space reserved for the commodities produced.

outfits.name: Korath Heat Shunt (Huge)
outfits.description: Korath weapons generate extreme amounts of heat, and the cooling systems they require can be massive.

outfits.name: Korath Scanner
outfits.description: Korath ships rarely rely on scanning technologies, preferring to shoot first and plunder later. The rare ship that does need it likely has one of these bulky systems installed. 	While not particularly powerful or sophisticated, the Korath's unorthodox approach to scanning has the unintended side effect of jamming radar based missile guidance systems.

Ships: Korath World Crafter (Kor Efret World Crafter)

outfits.name: Microbot Fabricator
outfits.description: Some Korath World-Ships are outfitted with the necessary equipment to operate full scale manufacturing facilities. 	This Microbot Fabricator is programmed to produce basic consumer goods such as clothing, medicine, and electronics that are easily traded at spaceports across the galaxy. However, your crew and passengers are your best customers. 	In addition to outfit space, this production outfit requires cargo space reserved for the commodities produced.

outfits.name: Reasoning Node (Damaged)
outfits.description: This miniature computer appears to be damaged. Hopefully it wasn't an important part of the systems for the ship it was installed on.

outfits.name: Security Circuit
outfits.description: This is some sort of supplementary computer processor meant to fortify the ship's self-defense systems. Removing this from a ship it is installed on before attempting to capture it should lessen the odds of triggering its self-destruct sequence. 	Installing this onto your own ship may help prevent its computer systems from being hacked.

outfits.name: Security Circuit (Damaged)
outfits.description: This Security Circuit burned out while thwarting an aggressive hacking attempt. It can no longer protect your ship from being hacked.

outfits.name: Security Node
outfits.description: This is some sort of supplementary computer processor meant to fortify the ship's self-defense systems. Removing this from a ship it is installed on before attempting to capture it should lessen the odds of triggering its self-destruct sequence. 	Installing this onto your own ship may help prevent its computer systems from being hacked.

outfits.name: Security Node (Damaged)
outfits.description: This Security Node burned out while thwarting an aggressive hacking attempt. It can no longer protect your ship from being hacked.

outfits.name: Shield Diluter
outfits.description: Shield Diluters utilize shield disruption technology to enable other weapons to penetrate the shields of the ship they are installed on. Kor Efret boarding crews occasionally attach these to the hull of an enemy ship. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Systems Core (Damaged)
outfits.description: Despite massive damage, this hybrid shield generator computer system is still operational to some degree. 	While unable to repair damage to complex systems such as itself, the machines controlled by this systems core can patch holes in the hull.

outfits.name: Systems Core (Huge)
outfits.description: This huge bank of computers, shield generators, and repair stations are designed to be used on massive World Ships and Space Stations.

Ships: Korath World Crafter (Kor Efret World Crafter)

outfits.name: Generator (Tinder Class)
outfits.description: Their preference for these supplemental generators instead of a standalone battery is a testament to the Korath's energy management philosophy.

outfits.name: Korath Generator (Small)
outfits.description: This miniature nuclear reactor was used by the Korath to power their fighters.

outfits.name: Korath Reactor (Large)
outfits.description: This massive reactor was designed by the Korath to meet the power needs of their largest ships.

outfits.name: Korath Thruster (Large)
outfits.description: This engine was used in the Korath capital ships.

outfits.name: Korath Steering (Large)
outfits.description: This engine was used in the Korath capital ships.

outfits.name: Fentra Predator
outfits.description: This feral creature was at the top of Sarisa Fentra's natural food chain. Like other surviving specimens kept in captivity by the Korath Exiles, the world it originated from can no longer support it. Unless kept in a proper habitat, it cannot survive in captivity. 	Fentra Predators are not trained to follow commands and offer no assistance in defending the ship. However releasing one onto an enemy vessel can be incredibly disruptive for defenders unprepared to deal with something so savage.

outfits.name: Meltdown Cannon
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this bears a resemblance to the Korath Thermal Repeater Rifle. It launches a glob of burning plasma that can melt though titanium on contact. It's possible that this is the last one of these weapons to exist. The heat it generates is so intense that it can melt its own components if not given adequate time to cool down.

outfits.name: Seleptra Bloom
outfits.description: The Korath admire Seleptra Blooms from a distance. If a creature wanders close enough, the plant releases a cloud of spores. While not lethal to living creatures, they can induce a deep sleep that leaves its victims vulnerable to predators. If an infested creature dies, the spores inside the corpse will begin to grow. 	Spores infesting flesh processed into Nutrigel by a microbot fabricator do not survive the process, leaving a product that is safe to consume. Nutrigel made from meat infused with Seleptra Bloom spores are also more flavorful to Korath tastebuds.

outfits.name: Pug Corroder
outfits.description: The Pug Corroder creates powerful energy bolts that disrupts the polarity of electrons that bind atoms together. This effect continues to damage the target after they strike.

outfits.name: Pug Corroder Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Corroder Turret creates powerful energy bolts that disrupts the polarity of electrons that bind atoms together. This effect continues to damage the target after they strike.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Seeker has a lower rate of fire than their regular Seeker. However, its slower projectiles have the ability to phase through obstacles and are unaffected by Anti-missiles. Even shields are less effective at stopping them.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Zapper
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Zapper fires an invisible beam that exerts force against whatever it hits.

outfits.name: Pug Ghost Zapper Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Ghost Zapper Turret fires invisible beams that exert force against whatever it hits.

outfits.name: Pug Ion Zapper
outfits.description: This Pug Zapper has been modified to add Ionic damage to the beam it generates.

outfits.name: Pug Ion Zapper Turret
outfits.description: The Pug Ion Zapper Turret delivers twice the ionic damage of the non-turreted version.

outfits.name: Pug Dual Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Dual Seeker mounts two Pug Seekers onto a single gun port, providing increased firepower.

outfits.name: Pug Thunder Seeker
outfits.description: The Pug Thunder Seeker fires homing energy projectiles much like the regular seeker. The difference is that these are more resilient against anti-missiles and explode more violently on impact.

outfits.name: Tier 2 Anti-Missile
outfits.description: The Pug's Tier 2 anti-missile system features both more power and a longer range with no increases in energy consumption or heat generated.

outfits.name: Jump Drive (Limit Fuel)
outfits.description: The workings of the jump drive are a total mystery. The best that human scientists have been able to find out is that this device is a containment field for matter in a state that cannot normally exist in this universe; if the drive is opened up, the field collapses and its contents disappear. Therefore, even though a few jump drives have been captured over the years, it has so far proved impossible to reverse engineer them. Damage to this Jump Drive has doubled the amount of fuel it consumes with each jump.

outfits.name: Pug Biobooster
outfits.description: This component produces the secretions that allow the Savage Pug's bio-regenerative hulls to repair themselves while providing protection and resistance against various dangerous elements present in harsh environments.

outfits.name: Pug Displacer
outfits.description: This strange obelisk creates a displacement field that makes it difficult for radar and optical tracking systems to target the ship it is installed on.

outfits.name: Pug Prognosticator
outfits.description: This seemingly innocuous obelisk is no mere decoration. It functions as a scanner that is able to read strategic tactical data over great distances.

outfits.name: Pug Shield Supplementer
outfits.description: The Pug use this basic supplementary system to boost the already formidable shield generation on their ships.

outfits.name: Pug Shield Reinforcer
outfits.description: The Pug use this enhanced supplementary system to boost the already formidable shield generation on their ships and reinforce them against anti-shield attacks.

outfits.name: Pug Akcorlo Engines
outfits.description: These engines are intended to be the primary means of locomotion for Pug fighters and drones.

outfits.name: Pug Maretar Thruster
outfits.description: This is a huge thruster designed by the Pug. It is not quite as powerful as a similarly sized atomic engine, but it makes up for that by being almost as energy efficient as ion engines.

outfits.name: Pug Maretar Steering
outfits.description: This is a huge steering system designed by the Pug. It is not quite as powerful as a similarly sized atomic engine, but it makes up for that by being almost as energy efficient as ion engines.

outfits.name: Pug Afterburner
outfits.description: Some Pug use this afterburner to supplement their normal thrusters. Unlike regular afterburners, it consumes more energy than fuel.

outfits.name: Dream Crystal
outfits.description: The Dream Crystal is a modified Pug Peacekeeping Staff that lacks the ability to emit a beam. When active, the Crystal incapacitates anyone near it by causing them to enter a euphoric and hallucinogenic state. Coming down from the state of euphoria is never pleasant. Pirates have found a variety of uses for these Crystals. Some use them to control slaves while others sell them as mind altering stimulators. Due to a brief delay in the time it takes to activate, it can be tossed like a grenade as well.

outfits.name: Pug Supplemental Shielding
outfits.description: The Pug use this basic supplementary system to boost the already formidable shield generation on their ships.

outfits.name: Elysian Trident
outfits.description: An even more destructive version of the Elysian Ranseur. While planetary defense commanders feel confident that such a display of awesome power would deter any from daring to attack the Quarg again, most tacticians do not consider the extra range and power this weapon provides to be worth the additional time spent recharging its energy coils.

outfits.name: Skyharpoon
outfits.description: These immensely powerful particle beam cannons are among the simplest weapons wielded by Quarg.

outfits.name: Void Scraper
outfits.description: This powerful ramscoop can accumulate fuel reserves even in deep space. The Quarg rarely utilize this device unless embarking on excursions far beyond the jump range of their ring worlds.

outfits.name: Jump Drive (Limit Distance)
outfits.description: The workings of the jump drive are a total mystery. The best that human scientists have been able to find out is that this device is a containment field for matter in a state that cannot normally exist in this universe; if the drive is opened up, the field collapses and its contents disappear. Therefore, even though a few jump drives have been captured over the years, it has so far proved impossible to reverse engineer them. Damage to this Jump Drive has limited its ability to travel without the aid of a hyperspace lane. Fortunately, its consumption of fuel has also been reduced.

outfits.name: Threat Analyzer
outfits.description: The Quarg consider their authority over the galaxy second only to the Drak. This device can be used to quickly assess suspicious ships for potential threats to the galactic order.

outfits.name: Targe Shield Generator
outfits.description: Even the smallest example of Quarg shield generation displays defensive powers greater than what humans would normally consider to be sufficient.

outfits.name: Accelerator Core
outfits.description: This antimatter device releases extreme amounts of energy in a simple, elegant package, all while producing surprisingly little waste heat.

outfits.name: Nanocell Battery
outfits.description: The energy density of Quarg batteries is unparalleled. 	Somehow, the battery chills itself as energy is drained from it, seemingly in defiance of the human understanding of thermodynamics.

outfits.name: Tiny Graviton Thruster
outfits.description: The mechanics of these tiny Quarg thrusters are inscrutable for your level of technological understanding. 	These engines also have strange capabilities which seem to violate the laws of physics as humanity understands them. Ships equipped with them accelerate faster under their own power than one would expect, while also taking less impact from external forces.

outfits.name: Tiny Graviton Steering
outfits.description: The mechanics of these tiny Quarg steering engines are inscrutable for your level of technological understanding. 	They also have strange capabilities which seem to violate the laws of physics as humanity understands them. Ships with these engines accelerate faster under their own power than one would expect, while also taking less impact from external forces.

outfits.name: Evidence of ********
outfits.description: Evidence of an atrocity that was committed. Some examples include but are not limited to: mutilated ******s, illegal *******s, and ******s of **** ***********. 	You're not sure how this got onto your ship, but it's probably in your best interest to get rid of it before you are accused of a horrible crime against all that is decent and good in the galaxy.

Missions: Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity
Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity (Capture Override)
Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity 2
Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity 3
Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity 4
Midnight Lost Orphan: Captain of Atrocity 5
Midnight Lost Orphan: Free Worlds Atrocity

outfits.name: Ancient Earth Pictograph
outfits.description: A picture of an artifact found in Earth ruins discovered under the western Sahara marshes. It depicts a crowd of prehistoric humans kneeling before a prominent figure of some importance. 	This photo is somewhat blurry, but still might be worth something to the right person...

outfits.name: Antimatter Core (Damaged)
outfits.description: Although this device is no longer functioning, it might still be worth something to the right people.

outfits.name: Celestial Compass
outfits.description: With the right mapping data, this alien device can project the movement of celestial objects across the galaxy.

outfits.name: Midnight's Lost Orphan
outfits.description: A parasitic incorporeal entity from another dimension. Midnight's Lost Orphan grants its host strange unnatural powers that can bend or warp time and space. 	However, the entity feeds on negative emotions and will manipulate the mental state of anyone nearby towards taking actions that cause strife, pain, and suffering among friend and foe alike. Crew productivity and teamwork takes a severe downturn whenever the entity is allowed to exert itself. A simple task that would normally take one crew member to perform can require two or three as tense arguments and disagreements hamper efficiency.

outfits.name: Nanotech Battery (Damaged)
outfits.description: Although this device is no longer functioning, it might still be worth something to the right people.

outfits.name: Obsolete Star Map
outfits.description: This star map is obsolete. Someone with the right knowledge may be able to use this data to extrapolate the current positions of these star systems.

outfits.name: Quantum Shield Generator (Damaged)
outfits.description: Although this device is no longer functioning, it might still be worth something to the right people.

outfits.name: Insurgent Subjugation Gear
outfits.description: This equipment is only used by the Quarg when it is necessary to educate violent species of the dangers resulting from insubordination. 	The Coalition are the youngest in the galaxy to have witnessed the mass deployment of these weapons. Their Enforcement Confrontation Gear is merely a weak replica when compared to the original.

outfits.name: Intrusion Countermeasure
outfits.description: Quarg ships are outfitted with special systems for repelling boarders. This is an older version of those systems which indiscriminately kills everything in the room it is installed in.

outfits.name: Phalanx Grenade
outfits.description: This rechargeable device is designed to be tossed at the enemy like a grenade. Instead of exploding, it sprays the enemy with bursts of laser fire until its charge runs out. It can be set as a trap to defend against boarders, but its charge doesn't last long. Although it was not made by the Quarg, stolen Quarg technology was used in its construction.

Missions: Midnight Gorgon Angry Squirrels - Phalanx Grenades

outfits.name: Quarg Graviton Generator
outfits.description: A weapon that once belonged to a rogue Quarg, the Graviton Generator causes a small singularity to appear temporarily at the distance and direction set by the wielder. Anything caught within the implosion point is instantly crushed from the extreme gravitational forces generated. Unlike traditional firearms, no projectile is actually launched from the weapon, rendering line of sight seemingly meaningless. 	Due to the potential collateral damage this weapon can cause, using it to defend your own ship from boarders is ill advised.

outfits.name: Quarg Quantum Phase Pistol
outfits.description: While the rogue Quarg who previously owned this could have wielded it in one hand, humans and other smaller species need both arms to use this Quantum Phase Pistol. Once locked onto the chosen target, it creates and fires a projectile which phases through any matter that would impede its trajectory. The technology that enables this weapon to work is beyond your understanding.

outfits.name: Quarg Skytrident
outfits.description: These immensely powerful particle beam weapons strike with such intensity that some of their damage penetrates shield defenses.

outfits.name: Tiny Graviton Reverser
outfits.description: Quarg thrusters are quite powerful for their size and produce very little heat, but at the cost of consuming immense amounts of energy. 	They also have strange capabilities which seem to violate the laws of physics as humanity understands them. Ships with these engines accelerate faster under their own power than one would expect given the thrust of their engines, while also taking less impact from external forces. 	Because a reverse thruster must be facing forwards, it must be installed in the weapon section of your ship instead of the engine section.

outfits.name: Modified Inhibitor
outfits.description: This modified version of the Inhibitor Cannon lacks the firing synchronization of the standard Remnant version. The result is that instead of firing a volley of inhibitor projectiles, a group of these weapons will produce a steady stream. Intimate knowledge of how the weapon works is necessary to make this sort of modification while leaving the weapon's other attributes unchanged.

outfits.name: Lightning Tendril
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the electrifying Luminazoa. The tentacle is difficult to control. The gunner must often struggle to aim at a target.

outfits.name: Flare Belcher
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the fire breathing Nova Fireflies. An extra tank of hyperspace fuel is included.

outfits.name: Quill Launcher
outfits.description: A weapon inspired by the prickly Star Gazers. There is a slight delay while it regenerates the quills used as ammunition.

outfits.name: EMP Torpedo Storage Depot
outfits.description: The EMP Torpedo Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use EMP torpedoes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Teciimach Canister Depot
outfits.description: The Teciimach Canister Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Teciimach Canisters. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: Engine Restraint
outfits.description: An Engine Restraint will reduce the mobility of any ship it is installed on. Remnant crews able to board an enemy ship may attach this device onto the enemy engine systems to sabotage their maneuverability. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Heart of Nightmare
outfits.description: The still living organ of some unknown alien creature throbs and quivers aboard the Ember Nightmare. Integrated into the ship's systems, it is not clear how this is kept alive. The system data indicates that its primary purpose involves providing the ship with a crude form of stealth via radar and optical jamming. If removed through conventional means, the organ would probably die.

outfits.name: Reverberator Rifle
outfits.description: A weapon stolen from Farpoint's evidence vault, this utilizes design concepts similar to those found in the Remant Tuning Rifle. While not as refined in its ability to pinpoint organs to liquefy, it's true potential is in the echo that grows in intensity as the soundwaves reverberate down spaceship corridors, eventually becoming strong enough to knock humans off their feet. As the sounds bounce off walls, they can even hit targets hiding behind corners. Unfortunately, this weapon is useless outside of the confines of a spaceship.

outfits.name: Void Rifle Display
outfits.description: This Void Rifle is a museuam quality display piece dating back several centuries. While the internal components no longer function, it has been well maintained by its previous owner. However as a weapon it is nothing more than a fancy club.

outfits.name: Inhibitor Blaster
outfits.description: This modified version of the Inhibitor Cannon lacks the firing synchronization of the standard Remnant version. The result is that instead of firing a volley of inhibitor projectiles, a group of these weapons will produce a steady stream. Intimate knowledge of how the weapon works is necessary to make this sort of modification while leaving the weapon's other attributes unchanged.

outfits.name: Remnant Fabricator License
outfits.description: The underlying secrets of Remnant technology are a closely guarded secret known only to those with the responsibility to produce it. Compartmentalization is key to safeguarding critical information.

outfits.name: EMP Torpedo Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture EMP Torpedos. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer EMP Torpedos even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The underlying secrets of Remnant technology are a closely guarded secret known only to those with the responsibility to produce it. Compartmentalization is key to safeguarding critical information. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: EMP Torpedo Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture EMP Torpedos. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer EMP Torpedos even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: Teciimach Canister Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Teciimach Canisters. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Teciimach Canisters even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The underlying secrets of Remnant technology are a closely guarded secret known only to those with the responsibility to produce it. Compartmentalization is key to safeguarding critical information. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

The underlying secrets of Remnant technology are a closely guarded secret known only to those with the responsibility to produce it. Compartmentalization is key to safeguarding critical information. outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Teciimach Canisters. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Teciimach Canisters even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The underlying secrets of Remnant technology are a closely guarded secret known only to those with the responsibility to produce it. Compartmentalization is key to safeguarding critical information. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: vyu-Ira Wound
outfits.description: This wound has severed the consciousness of the vyu-Ira from it's body. Any sentient being who enters it can interface with the ship and gain a modicum of control over it.

outfits.name: Abyssal Composer?
outfits.description: This is an extremely dangerous device that uses graviton technology to pull a target's mass and energy apart, and then feeds the materials to the firing ship's systems.

outfits.name: Fate Sealer?
outfits.description: An energy particle weapon that intensifies a blast to a single location after a brief duration. The after-effect of the explosion pulls the target closer to the origin of the blast.

outfits.name: Fate Divider?
outfits.description: An energy particle weapon that intensifies a blast to a single location after a brief duration. The after-effect of the explosion pushes the target farther from the origin of the blast.

outfits.name: Manifold Drive
outfits.description: The Manifold Drive folds space so that the point of origin and point of destination intersect. Then it unfolds the space. This effect can also be redirected at another ship with devastating results.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Anti-Missile
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Sheragi Anti-Missile on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Cannon
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of a Sheragi Particle Waveform Cannon.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Cyclotron
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Heavy Ion Cyclotron from the Black Diamond.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Fabricator
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Shard Fabricator on the Black Diamond.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Turret
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Particle Waveform Turret on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Cooling
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Large Hybrid Cooling on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi EWS
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Electronic Warfare System on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Medium Hybrid Cooling
outfits.description: This Sheragi cooling system works both actively and passively to dissipate heat while including a cryogenic fuel tank which is used as a temporary heat reservoir.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Battery
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Large EM Battery on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Medium EM Battery
outfits.description: This superconductive coil stores power while providing a boost to the shield regeneration of the ship.

outfits.name: Fake Sheragi Drive
outfits.description: This is a convincing recreation of the Fusion Drive on the Emerald Sword.

outfits.name: Reactor Drive
outfits.description: A smaller version of the Fusion Drive, the Reactor Drive still includes a hyperdrive, a reactor core, and powerful plasma engines.

outfits.name: High-Velocity Spike Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Star High-Velocity Spikes. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer High-Velocity Spikes even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This is technically not meant to be for sale. "But seeing as how thou art well-esteemed amongst the High Houses, perchance our outfitter shall be willing to impart it unto thee, shouldst thou be inclined to furnish us with an exorbitant sum, no less than ten times its rightful worth..." 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: High-Velocity Spike Tech License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture High-Velocity Spikes. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer High-Velocity Spikes even if it is normally not stocked there.

outfits.name: High-Velocity Spike Access Temporary License
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Star High-Velocity Spikes. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer High-Velocity Spikes even if it is normally not stocked there. 	This is technically not meant to be for sale. "But seeing as how thou art well-esteemed amongst the High Houses, perchance our outfitter shall be willing to impart it unto thee, shouldst thou be inclined to furnish us with an exorbitant sum, no less than ten times its rightful worth..." 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.

outfits.name: Old House Secrets
outfits.description: The data collected from scanning the mission target. The Old Houses will execute you if you are caught in posession of this.

outfits.name: New House Secrets
outfits.description: The data collected from scanning the mission target. The New Houses will execute you if you are caught in posession of this.

outfits.name: "Fajet" Coilgun
outfits.description: An improvised weapon assembled by the People's Houses, "Fajet" Coilguns fire an ionic spray which destabilizes shielding. The materials used to manufacture this appear to be higher in quality than what the People's Houses normally have access to. 	These weapons are often paired with "Nejet" Coilguns to simulate the effect of the Bimodal Coilguns used by the High Houses.

outfits.name: "Nejet" Coilgun
outfits.description: An improvised weapon assembled by the People's Houses, "Nejet" Coilguns fire hyperdense packets of charged particles that pierce armor. The materials used to manufacture this appear to be higher in quality than what the People's Houses normally have access to. 	These weapons are often paired with "Fajet" Coilguns to simulate the effect of the Bimodal Coilguns used by the High Houses

outfits.name: "Nefa" Coilgun Turret
outfits.description: An improvised weapon assembled by the People's Houses, the "Nefa" pairs a "Nejet" Coigun and a "Fajet" Coilgun onto a rotating turret mount to simulate the effect of the Bimodal Coilgun Turrets used by the High Houses. The materials used to manufacture this appear to be higher in quality than what the People's Houses normally have access to.

outfits.name: "Ojet" Coilgun Turret
outfits.description: This antiquated version of the Bimodal Coilgun Turret was discarded by the High Houses long ago. Occasionally a salvaged turret finds its way into the tentacles of a rogue from the People's Houses.

outfits.name: "Myiara" Fire Spout
outfits.description: Denounced as a "knave's weapon", this repurposed Inductive Reverser is designed to spew out superheated gouts of flaming hyperspace fuel. A "Myiara" Reverser Interlink can connect two "Myiara" Fire Spouts to synchronize their functionality as an engine.

outfits.name: High-Velocity Spike Depot
outfits.description: The High-Velocity Spike Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use High-Velocity Spikes. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to maintain inventory.

outfits.name: "Ej-Byiaa" Shield Pallium
outfits.description: Predecessor shield generators are designed to function independently, making them incompatible with a Cortex Interface.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Adaptor
outfits.description: The metamaterial armor of Successor warships can be altered in an appropriately equipped spaceport to change its attributes. 	This configuration allows modern Successor warships to implement Predecessor multimode configurations. It also adds some rudimentary hull repair, even to ships that don't already have it.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Cloak
outfits.description: You're sure the multimode cloaking armor is here somewhere, but you can't see it. 	Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that allows the armor to cloak if the ship's hull is undamaged.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Blood
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that allows a vessel to partially shrug off effects that would push or pull it off course. This a mere side effect of its true purpose, which allows a vessel equipped with it to safely pass through bloodstone gates.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Graviton
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that allows a vessel to partially shrug off effects that would push or pull it off course. 	There is some speculation that this configuration has some deeper function that has since been long forgotten...

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Thermal
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that insulates the armor against heat and is highly resistant to burning.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Pristine
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that strengthens the armor's structure against corrosion.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Regen
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that boosts hull repair, even adding it to ships that don't already have it.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Stealth
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration that causes the armor to interfere with certain hostile scanning and tracking methods.

outfits.name: Multimode Armor: Plate
outfits.description: Implementing the Predecessor's multimode configurations onto modern Successor warships requires a few extra steps and materials that are unknown to most... 	This material results in a configuration of layered plates that appears to be an early attempt at multimodal hardened armor.

outfits.name: "Tundra" Espionage Scanner
outfits.description: The Predecessors strategic scanners were used to discern the unfamiliar technologies of other species. They could also track data that their Successors cannot.

outfits.name: "Veldt" Overcharge Scanner
outfits.description: This overcharged "Veldt" Combat Scanner is more efficent at scanning cargo than the ones utilized by the High Houses. To accomplish this without compromising the scanner range requires a significant increase in energy consumption.

outfits.name: "Irja" Fusion Core
outfits.description: This appears to be a Predecessor reactor. It is far superior to the "Nnesa" Fusion Core used by the High Houses. Their larger reactors must have been similarly impressive.

outfits.name: "Myiara" Reverser Interlink
outfits.description: This device is required to synchronize engine functionality to a pair of "Myiara" Fire Spouts.

outfits.name: Photon Blade
outfits.description: An inelegant weapon from a less civilized age, this is an artifact of the ancient Predecessors. Many knights of the old empire lost at least one of their tentacles while engaging in Photon Blade duels. 	Given enough time, this weapon can probably cut through stone. Avoid striking shiny surfaces like the Successor's liquid metal armor. The reflection of the blade could prove fatal.

outfits.name: Shadow House License
outfits.description: House Sado, a relic from an antediluvian age, still operates in the shadows of a once great civilization. As their willing pawn, you can receive certain services and missions from them.

outfits.name: Thunderhead Pod
outfits.description: A primitive version of the modern Thunderhead Launcher. The Thunderhead Pod is almost entirely dependent on external ammunition storage, resulting in a slower rate of fire. Unlike the modern launchers, these pods do not fire simultaneously when multiples are installed on a ship.

outfits.name: Thunderhead Storage Depot
outfits.description: The Thunderhead Storage Depot stages extra ammunition in your cargo bay for weapons that use Thunderhead Missiles. The ammunition is ready to be withdrawn for use. Storing it this way uses more cargo space than if it were packed away in sealed crates. An extra crewmember is required to oversee maintenance of the ammunition.

outfits.name: Anti-Ionic Plating
outfits.description: The result of Wanderer research into the nature of ionic damage, resistance, and protection.

outfits.name: Armament Pacifier
outfits.description: When faced with the threat of being boarded, Wanderer crews may place this device onto the attacking ship. Using an Armament Pacifier is unlikely to help the defending crew. However, any ship this is installed on will have trouble using its weapons to attack other ships. 	If you find this installed on your ship, get rid of it as soon as possible!

outfits.name: Wanderer Advanced Cooling
outfits.description: Developed by Wanderer researchers after studying the ringworld debris you provided to them, this Wanderer cooling system is far more advanced than what they developed previously.

outfits.name: Wanderer Crafter License
outfits.description: The Wanderers view their weapons of war as [shameful, a necessary evil]. They are averse to allowing the secrets of crafting them to [proliferate, propagate] across the galaxy.

outfits.name: Thunderhead Access Temporary
outfits.description: This technical manual details how to manufacture Thunderheads. Having this makes it possible for any outfitter to offer Thunderheads even if it is normally not stocked there. 	The Wanderers view their weapons of war as [shameful, a necessary evil]. They are averse to allowing the secrets of crafting them to [proliferate, propagate] across the galaxy. 	This tech can be researched instead of purchased. (Hover/Tap the attributes below for more details.) 	After this is acquired it can be found in the Licenses area in future visits to the outfitter.
